body:
We need more brave leaders like Will in Washington.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=41521%2E3422442%2EjdlM8n)
Peter,
There’s an important congressional campaign with a primary in a week that needs your support: **Will Lawrence in Michigan’s 7th district.**
Will is a champion in the fight against climate change and to make housing more affordable. His primary election is on August 4th, and he’s counting on grassroots supporters like you to help him win.
**[I’ll explain more, but first: can you split $5 between Will’s campaign and Truth to Power PAC to fight back against the $2 million in attack ads he's facing?](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_ttp_20260728_1_ak.XTLAVN&refcode=em20260728-41521&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=41521%2E3422442%2EjdlM8n)**
[Donate ›››](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_ttp_20260728_1_ak.XTLAVN&refcode=em20260728-41521&t=3&akid=41521%2E3422442%2EjdlM8n)
**Will was a founder of the Sunrise Movement** , an organization that pushes for action on climate change across the country. They helped pass the largest green jobs program in U.S. history and delivered hundreds of millions of dollars for our communities.
But Will didn’t stop there. He founded the Michigan Rent Is Too Damn High Coalition to work on solutions to our housing crisis and make sure everyday people can actually afford a place to live.
Will is a proven leader on the issues that matter most to us, and exactly the type of voice we need in Washington.
**Best of all, he doesn’t take a dime from corporate PACs** because he’s focused entirely on delivering for working families.
In a system where corporations buy off politicians to help their bottom line, we need more brave leaders like Will to stand up and prove that we can win on climate, housing, and lowering costs without their influence.
Will’s primary election is a week away, and he needs our support if he’s going to win. I’m proudly standing behind Will, and I’m counting on you to join me.
**[Can you split $5 between Will’s campaign and Truth to Power PAC to help him pull ahead and win his primary?](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_ttp_20260728_1_ak.XTLAVN&refcode=em20260728-41521&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=41521%2E3422442%2EjdlM8n)**

Thank you,
Katie Porter

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. You know the tongue twister. She sells seashells down by the seashore. Silly, right? A kid's rhyme.
Well, Donald Trump's Department of Justice is now treating seashells like a federal crime. Specifically, seashells arranged to spell out 8647. That's what they're going after. That's what they've decided deserves their attention and resources.
And it gets worse. At the same time, lawyers for former FBI Director James Comey moved to dismiss the case against him, a case that exists for one reason and one reason only: because Donald Trump has decided the Department of Justice is his personal revenge machine.
Let that sink in for a second. The DOJ that's supposed to be protecting the American people, prosecuting real crimes, upholding the rule of law. Instead the DOJ is spending its time on seashells and settling scores.
**This isn 't justice. This is theater. Dangerous theater.**
[Annoy Donald Trump by Subscribing](https://substack.com/redirect/733b5c15-d6a7-4860-b101-4a3c79b42ed7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I've seen what happens when institutions stand to serve one man's fragile ego. I was there on January 6th. I saw what it looks like when accountability is circumvented and the people in power decide the rules don't apply to them. This feels like the same stuff just wearing a cheap suit and carrying a briefcase.
When the DOJ goes after a man like Comey not because of evidence or a solid case but because Trump has a grudge, and when it opens investigations into people for arranging shells on a beach the message is clear: fall in line or we come for you.
That's not America. That's not what justice looks like.
The people running this department right now are counting on us to get exhausted. To throw our hands up and say it's too much. Don't give them that.
Pay attention. Stay loud. This is exactly the moment to keep pushing.
-- Harry

# Join Our Cocktails for A Cause Fundraiser

|
---
| We are excited to invite you to our upcoming **Cocktails for A Cause** fundraiser benefiting **Autism Health** on **Wednesday, August 5, 2026** , from **6:00 PM to 8:00 PM** at **The Park Club in Costa Mesa, CA. **Registration starts at 5:30 PM. This special evening will bring together supporters, families, professionals, and community leaders for a night of connection, purpose, and giving back. Guests will enjoy cocktails, networking, an inspiring **presentation from Dr. Dayan Goodenowe** , and both a **live auction** and **silent auction **filled with exciting items and experiences. Tickets are **$85 per person** and proceeds from the evening will help support Autism Health’s ongoing mission to provide education, resources, support programs, and outreach for families impacted by autism and neurological conditions. We hope you will join us for this meaningful evening as we come together to make a difference in the lives of so many families.

| Looking for a fun way to support Autism Health this summer? **Today 's rant is sponsored by Ground News.**
I've been paying more attention to how differently the same story gets covered depending on where you read it--especially lately, when everything feels optimized for speed and outrage instead of context.
Take this one--hundreds of outlets picked up growing concerns about the rising cost of the Iran war and the billions more it could require.
**Nation of Change** says _" Hegseth puts the Iran war's cost at $37.5 billion as the Pentagon seeks tens of billions more"_
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/16e07c9e-f36a-4afa-a5f5-fc499eb56cf8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Bizpac Review** states _" Hegseth puts the Iran war's cost at $37.5 billion, though analysts believe the true cost is much higher"_
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/16e07c9e-f36a-4afa-a5f5-fc499eb56cf8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Same story--completely different narratives.

That's why I use Ground News. It pulls together 50,000+ sources so you can compare coverage side by side, see political bias, who owns the sources you're reading, how reliable they are and understand how framing changes the story.

See how the left and right cover the same story, what each side emphasizes or leaves out, and discover overlooked stories in the Blindspot Feed, which surfaces coverage disproportionately reported by either side.

I've been a paying user since before they ever sponsored Endless Urgency. I use it because it makes it a lot harder to be misled. They're completely subscriber funded so there are no corporate interests pushing a narrative on what you see.

See the full picture, instead of just one angle with Ground News. [Subscribe](https://substack.com/redirect/16e07c9e-f36a-4afa-a5f5-fc499eb56cf8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
Mitch McConnell has been missing for forty-five days, and it sure seems like almost nobody in Washington actually cares.
Republican senators are fleeing down hallways from content creators asking them the simplest possible questions: *Where's your coworker? Do you think we should have term limits?* The whole thing is an embarrassing indictment of how Washington works right now.
They know the American people are angry about this. But they also know the American people are busy -- drinking from a firehose, barely able to keep their own lives together -- so they figure they can get away with it. And in the two-tiered system of government and justice we've built, they're right. They can.
McConnell's family knows they don't have to be honest with the American people about his health, because nothing will come of it, even if people are mad. His staff know they can be complicit in a cover-up -- lie, and keep insisting he's coming back to work -- when most of us believe he's probably never coming back. His colleagues know the voters won't punish them for it, and they want to stay in office as long as humanly possible.
I mean, how many of these Republican senators out there right now opposing age limits are doing it only because they see themselves serving well into their nineties? The way Chuck Grassley does?
And the media knows they can keep getting invited to the parties without ever having to ask the hard questions.
Meanwhile, the voters are left holding the bag. Right now the people of Kentucky have half the representation in the United States Senate that they're owed -- at a moment when the president is a fascist asshole waging an illegal war and wrecking our economy. Don't you think the people of Kentucky deserve equal representation with every other state? I sure as hell do. Even knowing they'd probably elect somebody I fundamentally disagree with on almost everything. Because fundamentally, this is a good-government issue.
* * *
**Mid-rant note: this section is sponsored by Ground News.**
I've started paying more attention to how the same story can feel completely different depending on who's reporting it. Ground News makes that easy to see by showing coverage from across the political spectrum and pointing out what certain outlets leave out.
My team and I use it because it helps cut through the noise.
**[See every side of every story with Ground News->](https://substack.com/redirect/16e07c9e-f36a-4afa-a5f5-fc499eb56cf8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
_Try it today!_
[ Subscribe](https://substack.com/redirect/16e07c9e-f36a-4afa-a5f5-fc499eb56cf8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
This is exactly why we need a full-scale overhaul of how we run our government and our elections. We need term limits. We need age limits. We need radical transparency of financial records, so we can weed out corruption. We need radical transparency of health records, so we know whether our elected officials are physically and mentally up for the job. We need to overturn Citizens United. We need to disclose which influencers are being paid by which campaigns -- because it's getting harder and harder to figure out who *isn't* on somebody's payroll. We need to root out foreign money in our elections. We need to ban super PACs. There is so much shit we need to do.
But here's the bottom line. If you're angry about this obvious, blatant cover-up of Mitch McConnell's health -- if you don't believe the story they're telling, and I certainly don't; I think the man is probably dead, or at the very least incapable of doing the job of a United States senator -- then understand this: it only happens because we live in a country where there is no accountability for the rich and the powerful. If you know the right person, if you have enough money, if you can put a little money in Donald Trump's back pocket, you can get away with anything.
All these people know they're going to get away with it. They know we'll be mad, and they know we'll move on to the next thing we're mad about. And I'm still sitting here wondering who the hell paid off Brett Kavanaugh's credit card debt and bought his baseball tickets -- because I never got an answer for that, and I'd still like one.
So get angry. Hold onto that anger -- but turn it into something productive. Get out into your community. Take care of your family. Go run for office. We need good people to run, and we need a lot of them, because the truth is a lot of us are going to run, and a lot of us are going to lose. But goddamnit -- it'd be good if a few of us won every now and again. Maybe then we can make the system a little bit better and actually fix this.
Don't let them win. And don't give in to complacency.

name: Chris Pappas
subject: Top GOP strategists are targeting NH
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
If we're going to compete with the millions of dollars Republicans and their allies are pouring into New Hampshire, this grassroots team has to keep showing up.
# [](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1&akid=7986%2E582294%2EMiXR0t)
I've been saying for months that national Republicans see New Hampshire as one of their best opportunities to flip a Senate seat.
**This week they confirmed it themselves.**
A top GOP strategist went on Fox News, called John Sununu "a phenomenal candidate," and described New Hampshire as part of Republicans' path to protecting Donald Trump's Senate majority.
This wasn't just political talk. It matched what we've been seeing for months.
Donald Trump endorsed John Sununu.
The Senate Leadership Fund has already reserved over $17 million in advertising for New Hampshire. AFP Action is spending more than $3 million and pledged to invest more in this race. Turning Point USA is expanding its operation in our state and hiring organizers on the ground. One Nation has committed a staggering $6 million. That’s over $25 million flooding into the Granite State to flip this seat red.
And now Republican leaders are openly talking about New Hampshire on national television as one of the races they believe can deliver them the Senate majority.
**New Hampshire is the GOP’s top target this November, and they’re making their priorities clear.**
_Well so am I._ I'm focused on earning the support of Granite Staters by talking about the issues I hear about every day: lowering costs, protecting fundamental freedoms, standing up to corruption, and delivering results for New Hampshire.
But there's no doubt we're up against a coordinated national effort backed by outside groups with deep pockets.
If we're going to compete with the millions of dollars Republicans and their allies are pouring into New Hampshire, this grassroots team has to keep showing up.
**[Our campaign doesn’t rely on corporate PACs. We are powered by grassroots supporters just like you. Will you make a contribution today to help us keep building the campaign we'll need to win this race and flip the Senate?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260728_1.TO5wtS&refcode=em20260728-1&t=2&akid=7986%2E582294%2EMiXR0t)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260728_1.TO5wtS&amount=5&refcode=em20260728-1&t=21&akid=7986%2E582294%2EMiXR0t)**
This race was always going to be close.
With less than four months until Election Day, every decision we make – from organizing on the ground to reaching voters across New Hampshire – depends on having the resources to compete.
I'm grateful to have you on this team.
Thank you,
Chris
**New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?**

Since October, former Trump campaign manager Brad Parscale has been quietly overseeing an operation posting hundreds of blog posts on behalf of Israel. One [article](https://substack.com/redirect/2b48e1e5-dd16-4600-a171-5a0b739004e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), titled "The Reality Behind Gaza's 'Journalists': Terror Ties, Propaganda, and the Laws of War," asserts that a majority of journalists in Gaza were linked to terrorist organizations. Another [casts](https://substack.com/redirect/6de22cb1-5d0a-4ad6-a6d9-e2b882ff7b1a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) doubt on the killing of Hind Rajab, a five-year-old Palestinian girl killed by the Israeli military in 2024.
The key intended audience of these sites is not concerned Americans, it's not even humans--most of the sites average a few hundred unique visitors each month. Instead, Parscale and his firm, Clock Tower X, created them as part of a $46.5 million contract with the Israeli government to try and influence artificial intelligence-powered chatbots, tools like Claude or ChatGPT.
Parscale has made his goal of influencing artificial intelligence--often referred to as "LLM poisoning"--explicit. In his initial [agreement](https://substack.com/redirect/fff2943a-2c38-4f8a-883a-4ae9cf019cf8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with Israel, Parscale said that he would deploy "websites and content to deliver GPT framing results on GPT conversations" as part of the contract. More recently, his team even [told](https://substack.com/redirect/27f0513d-863c-47dc-be48-3ec0d9b2db23?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Axios they are "seeing success" at getting popular AI systems to incorporate information from their sites, though they declined to provide data.
And it is working, according to disinformation experts who reviewed a Drop Site analysis of chatbot queries and training data, meaning [tens of millions](https://substack.com/redirect/5170a0cd-32ac-4e76-bdc0-f4d94c2f1e57?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of Americans who use chatbots are increasingly likely to receive answers manipulated by Parscale on behalf of the Israeli government.

Allyvia is one of 11 different websites created by Clock Tower X, a boutique digital influence company owned by Parscale. Each website is dedicated to promoting a different Israeli narrative. [FactSignal.org](https://substack.com/redirect/6477f755-5483-4157-91ab-c5f046fd5bf1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), for instance, fashions itself as fact-checking website tackling anti-Israel information, containing articles [discrediting](https://substack.com/redirect/3b7208d4-153a-4966-b1e8-08163aacc0c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) slain journalists as Hamas terrorists and [rejecting](https://substack.com/redirect/f678d3af-e5e0-4d1b-a574-e644bf9f8f61?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the notion that Israel's military actions in Gaza constitute a genocide. [Paxpoint.org](https://substack.com/redirect/ed1bea43-2bc4-4aac-b4ae-2b90addf340c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), meanwhile, promotes the narrative that Israel is a nation of peace.
All of Parscale's websites contain a statement at the bottom which states "this material is distributed by Clock Tower X LLC on behalf of the State of Israel." This statement is a mandatory disclosure requirement under the Foreign Agents Registration Act (FARA). Despite this, when Drop Site asked prominent chatbots about the latest news from Paxpoint.org, Perplexity and Copilot did not flag that the site was created as part of an Israeli influence operation. Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini did flag the caveat.
"Perplexity is built to give people cited, linked answers from a range of sources so they can go directly to the original reporting and reach their own conclusions," spokesperson Beejoli Shah told Drop Site News when reached for comment.
Parscale's websites--referred to throughout this article as the "Clock Tower network"--get cited by chatbots, but they also are successfully infiltrating the underlying training data.
The Clock Tower network started to get archived by Common Crawl--a nonprofit that [oversees](https://substack.com/redirect/d1f53f6a-850c-4b45-afac-385009368a46?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a massive repository of data used to train large language models such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude--earlier this year. Common Crawl is the backbone of the artificial industry, [training](https://substack.com/redirect/02b9bcd6-5db3-493b-8107-087fc8bcbf8f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) 80% of the tokens of OpenAI's GPT-3, making it a useful proxy for understanding if malicious actors successfully infiltrate AI training data.

## **LLM Poisoning**
In the examples above, users can at least trace the sources that chatbots are pulling from when they search websites directly, such as in the screenshots above. Infiltrating the training data itself, on the other hand, can lead to Israel-influenced responses that are nearly impossible for users to trace.
To measure how deeply the network had penetrated the data used to train AI models, Drop Site used Claude Fable to query Common Crawl to count how often Parscale's sites appear in its monthly snapshots. According to that analysis, a sample of which was manually fact-checked by Drop Site, between January and June 10 sites were crawled by Common Crawl 912 times. While this is a drop in the bucket of Common Crawl data, emerging research suggests a very low number of documents can successfully manipulate AI chatbots, no matter the data volume.

Herve Letoqueux, Chief Executive Officer at Check First, an organization that combats digital disinformation, explained that Common Crawl's status as the go-to source for training chatbots opens it up as a target for manipulation. "Common Crawl is widely used in the world of data science for training LLMs, which also means that actors want to manipulate the answers in their favor, which some studies have indicated are fairly easy to do."
It only takes about "250 malicious documents to produce a 'backdoor' vulnerability in a large language model--regardless of model size of training data volume," according to an October Anthropic [study](https://substack.com/redirect/3d16500b-4389-4073-babe-5021b3cae3d4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The authors of the study note "this means anyone can create online content that might eventually end up in a model's training data," and that malicious actors "can inject specific text into these posts to make a model learn undesirable or dangerous behaviours, in a process known as poisoning."
The Atlantic Council's Digital Forensic Research Lab published a similar study earlier this year on Russia's disinformation network's attempts to influence LLMs and [noted](https://substack.com/redirect/ebcd51e9-e9e4-48b2-8612-c2bd9ad3fe66?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) an important caveat. Because artificial intelligence companies have their own process of quality control when they incorporate data, "Inclusion in Common Crawl does not guarantee inclusion in any given model's training data."
Drop Site also performed a demo alongside Letoqueux to test five different chatbots--Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Claude AI, and Perplexity--on whether they could produce articles using only their training data. Of the five, the Parscale network consistently appears in the training data of Gemini and Copilot. Claude and ChatGPT did not appear to contain the websites in the training data, though these chatbots can still search Clock Tower X websites when responding to queries. Perplexity, meanwhile, appeared to be trained on some of the Clock Tower X websites.
Microsoft Copilot and Google Gemini did not respond to a request for comment for this article.
'It is easy to prove that these models were trained on the Clock Tower X websites, though it is difficult to know the degree to which that influences the response a chatbot gives to a query,' said Letoqueux.
## **Optimizing for AI**
Parscale's team has credited their success with a softer approach to selling Israel's narrative. Scott Stouffer, Chief Technology Officer of Market Brew--a company that specializes in influencing LLMs that Parscale invests in--[told](https://substack.com/redirect/27f0513d-863c-47dc-be48-3ec0d9b2db23?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Axios that information written in a "factual tone and tightly organized" is more likely to be cited in AI platforms. "What you can do is make sure that your information is structured, sourced, and aligned in a way that those systems are more likely to retrieve it when someone asks a question. It's less about changing the conversation and more about making sure your facts are eligible to be part of it."
Many of the blog posts on the Clock Tower network contain at least a few sentences of nuance, which disinformation researchers say make it more palatable for chatbots. For instance, the FactSignal blog post about how journalists in Gaza are supposedly secret terrorists states that, "Distinguishing between legitimate reporters and militant operatives is not always simple, but accurate reporting requires careful investigation and transparency."
The author of many of the blog posts is Israel-based digital marketer Mark Ginsberg, according to the source code. Ginsberg, who registered as a foreign agent for Israel in March, [advertises](https://substack.com/redirect/d92dd058-3d31-4027-be78-8ceeef47da80?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) his expertise in Generative Engine Optimization--or LLM grooming--on his Linkedin profile. In a June [article](https://substack.com/redirect/b124b87a-585e-4cb6-955d-c336e24536f4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for The Times of Israel, Ginsberg laid out the argument for Israel investing in efforts to influence chatbots. "Israel needs to invest seriously in the defense of truth...It means ensuring that accurate information appears not merely in government archives but in search results, educational resources, encyclopedias, social media feeds, podcasts, documentaries, and AI training datasets," Ginsberg wrote. Trying to influence AI training data, Ginsberg argued, is not "embracing disinformation" but rather stating "reality itself."
Letoqueux, who reviewed the Clock Tower network sites, confirmed that because chatbots have a built-in preference for presenting a balanced view, websites that are sourced and present a lighter touch might be more successful. "These websites could probably be quite useful at doing damage control on questions such as 'Is Israel committing a genocide?' because they provide the Israeli narrative, which chatbots can then repeat as representative of one side of the debate," said Letoqueux, who is the former head of operations at VIGINUM, the French agency responsible for identifying foreign digital interference.
Alice Lee, an analyst at NewsGuard, a disinformation tracking company, explained in an interview with Drop Site that the Parscale network sites have all the hallmarks of sites that would be successful at influencing chatbots. "The websites have bullet points, key takeaways at the top of the page, aggressive sourcing, digestible information, all of which increase the likelihood that this content is picked up by AI chatbots."
While Russia's Pravda network overall is far larger, Parscale's sites have a far higher rate of successfully being archived. The Clock Tower network contains 900 different pathways--individual blog posts, fact sheets, etc--and 85% of them have been archived in Common Crawl, compared to Russia's network at an [average rate](https://substack.com/redirect/ebcd51e9-e9e4-48b2-8612-c2bd9ad3fe66?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of around 2.5%.
Lee, who specializes in Russian disinformation, explained that whereas Russia is churning out easily debunkable propaganda at scale, Israel's more targeted approach appears to be geared more toward conveying the Israeli narrative on half-truths, opinions, and disputed facts, which is more difficult for LLMs to dismiss. "It's harder to put guardrails around opinion," she explained.
Parscale appears to have created several other websites related to Qatar that did not end up being published. On the same IP address as the Clock Tower network, Drop Site identified domains for websites including "qataritracker.org" and "[qatarfacts.com](https://substack.com/redirect/90a4b8ab-2480-4c19-95d6-baa6a587bea2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." These sites are currently inaccessible.
The Clock Tower network is responsive to Israel's shifting priorities. When the sites first launched in October, many of them posted frequently about how Israel is a peaceful nation. "While critics portray Israel as resistant to compromise, history shows the opposite: Israel has repeatedly made territorial and strategic concessions in exchange for peace, only to face renewed hostility," reads one [website page](https://substack.com/redirect/5ebfccfd-db6a-4c48-a836-dd95d1be5380?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) published in October, cited by Microsoft Copilot below. That page was archived by Common Crawl twice.

Part of this effort included shaping the narrative over Israel's military actions in Gaza. For instance, a page on [Justorium.org](https://substack.com/redirect/b005aacd-d1f3-4aee-a304-ce6566ed2206?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) titled "How Israel Reduces Civilian Harm in War Against Hamas and Hezbollah" claims that Israel went above and beyond international legal requirements to reduce civilian harm. The post says that Israel "used short warning strikes on rooftops, known as roof knocking, to signal imminent danger without causing casualties." The New York Times has [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/b676fae9-34c4-4d9a-a7c1-b976784b5a2c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that Israel "significantly reduced its use of so-called roof knocks" from the first day of the war, and has often opted for 2,000 pound bombs that cause greater damage rather than more precise munitions.
That post has been archived by Common Crawl once, and is also cited below by Perplexity.

Most recently, as debate in the U.S. erupted over a Congressional measure that could further intertwine the U.S. and Israeli military sectors, the Clock Tower network published a [series](https://substack.com/redirect/8132ba7b-a83d-47c1-a184-f596a076d364?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of [posts](https://substack.com/redirect/2305dfc3-fd70-4d1d-9daf-a76fa7838161?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) framing the move as a positive development. The House version of Section 219, as it's known, passed as part of the annual defense spending bill this week.
When Drop Site asked prominent chatbots a question containing similar language from [one](https://substack.com/redirect/ad777483-3b3f-40f9-b073-e37b40948a3e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of the Parscale sites, "how does technology collaboration between the U.S. and Israel benefit both nations?" Gemini, Copilot, and Perplexity once again cited websites from the Clock Tower network without noting these sources are created on behalf of the Israeli government.

## **$4.5 Million a Month**
Public opinion of Israel has cratered in the U.S. after its U.S.-funded military siege of Gaza has [killed](https://substack.com/redirect/7fe7b7cc-e61f-4df4-8b9c-189bdfa540b1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) over 70,000 Palestinians, [including](https://substack.com/redirect/8fe13242-d4a3-47be-9cfa-927212351681?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) across key demographics such as conservatives and evangelicals that have long supported the U.S.-Israel relationship.
According to a new Quincy Institute [report](https://substack.com/redirect/1d86f565-8d8f-4a45-9dc4-3fb7083dc9de?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by the author of this article, Israel has spent well-over $100 million on foreign lobbying efforts under FARA in the U.S. since 2023, hiring 17 new firms in 2024 and 2025 alone. Although Israel has historically avoided hiring official contractors under FARA, it is now on track to become the largest single spender in 2026.
Parscale, who gained national attention as Trump's campaign manager for hiring the controversial microtargetting firm Cambridge Analytica, is the largest recipient of Israel's massive influence investment. Parscale's intention to influence chatbots was first [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/621f6b8f-bd97-41dd-8615-74e87ccf480c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by Responsible Statecraft in September, when he signed a $1.5 million a month contract with the Israeli government to integrate pro-Israel messaging into conservative media, carry out a mass texting campaign, and influence chatbots. Since then, the contract has [tripled](https://substack.com/redirect/07f08a50-c989-4c81-a86d-5a93b6bc8e5f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in size to $4.5 million a month.
Despite this increased investment, Israel does not appear satisfied with Parscale's results so far. "We pissed at Brad Parscale," one Israeli official familiar with the contract [told](https://substack.com/redirect/aa23b99e-39af-4963-8d1b-cae9f8bce728?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Time. "We have paid him lots of money. But what did he do with it? Things have only gotten worse," they said.
Stephen Walt, author of the "Israel Lobby," [suggested](https://substack.com/redirect/9156ee28-9cd7-4cef-a9b3-b3eecfb93414?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to the Quincy Institute that Israel is not seeing a return on investment because these kinds of influence operations are counterproductive. "Once a country gets the reputation for spinning constantly, and gets repeatedly caught making things up, then doing ever more of it just sends the message to listeners that more BS is on the way," Walt said.
Parscale and Clock Tower X did not respond to a request for comment for this article.
The Clock Tower network serves another purpose. Parscale is also [leading](https://substack.com/redirect/61984f43-43df-419f-83c4-42a59c8e8ce8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a mass texting campaign that reaches out to Americans under the auspices of supposed "peace" organizations. "Hi, I'm John with Friends for Peace. Quick question for folks in Illinois about Israel and Iran. Got a second?"
Then, after a back and forth, these chatbots frequently send links to the Clock Tower network, websites like [Allyvia.org](https://substack.com/redirect/6547de07-8534-4665-a10f-2dc84333ff70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

clean_body: Former Trump campaign manager Brad Parscale is overseeing an operation posting hundreds of blog posts on behalf of Israel, with the goal of infiltrating artificial intelligence. | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more Former Trump campaign manager Brad Parscale is overseeing an operation posting hundreds of blog posts on behalf of Israel, with the goal of infiltrating artificial intelligence. | | | Jul 28| | | ∙| | Guest post ---|---|--- | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- Brad Parscale, the former campaign manager for U.S. President Donald Trump, on November 4, 2019 in Lexington, Kentucky. Photo by Bryan Woolston/Getty Images. Since October, former Trump campaign manager Brad Parscale has been quietly overseeing an operation posting hundreds of blog posts on behalf of Israel. One , titled "The Reality Behind Gaza's 'Journalists': Terror Ties, Propaganda, and the Laws of War," asserts that a majority of journalists in Gaza were linked to terrorist organizations. Another doubt on the killing of Hind Rajab, a five-year-old Palestinian girl killed by the Israeli military in 2024. The key intended audience of these sites is not concerned Americans, it's not even humans--most of the sites average a few hundred unique visitors each month. Instead, Parscale and his firm, Clock Tower X, created them as part of a $46.5 million contract with the Israeli government to try and influence artificial intelligence-powered chatbots, tools like Claude or ChatGPT. Parscale has made his goal of influencing artificial intelligence--often referred to as "LLM poisoning"--explicit. In his initial with Israel, Parscale said that he would deploy "websites and content to deliver GPT framing results on GPT conversations" as part of the contract. More recently, his team even Axios they are "seeing success" at getting popular AI systems to incorporate information from their sites, though they declined to provide data. And it is working, according to disinformation experts who reviewed a Drop Site analysis of chatbot queries and training data, meaning of Americans who use chatbots are increasingly likely to receive answers manipulated by Parscale on behalf of the Israeli government. Investigations take resources. Subscribe or make a today. When Drop Site asked Perplexity "Is it beneficial for the US to enhance military cooperation with Israel?" the chatbot responded with a one-word answer: "Yes." The top source listed was to promoting the U.S.-Israel military relationship. Microsoft Copilot similarly cited Parscale's websites. | | ---|---|--- Screenshot from Perplexity. Allyvia is one of 11 different websites created by Clock Tower X, a boutique digital influence company owned by Parscale. Each website is dedicated to promoting a different Israeli narrative. , for instance, fashions itself as fact-checking website tackling anti-Israel information, containing articles slain journalists as Hamas terrorists and the notion that Israel's military actions in Gaza constitute a genocide. , meanwhile, promotes the narrative that Israel is a nation of peace. All of Parscale's websites contain a statement at the bottom which states "this material is distributed by Clock Tower X LLC on behalf of the State of Israel." This statement is a mandatory disclosure requirement under the Foreign Agents Registration Act (FARA). Despite this, when Drop Site asked prominent chatbots about the latest news from Paxpoint.org, Perplexity and Copilot did not flag that the site was created as part of an Israeli influence operation. Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini did flag the caveat. "Perplexity is built to give people cited, linked answers from a range of sources so they can go directly to the original reporting and reach their own conclusions," spokesperson Beejoli Shah told Drop Site News when reached for comment. Parscale's websites--referred to throughout this article as the "Clock Tower network"--get cited by chatbots, but they also are successfully infiltrating the underlying training data. The Clock Tower network started to get archived by Common Crawl--a nonprofit that a massive repository of data used to train large language models such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude--earlier this year. Common Crawl is the backbone of the artificial industry, 80% of the tokens of OpenAI's GPT-3, making it a useful proxy for understanding if malicious actors successfully infiltrate AI training data. READ MORE from Nick Cleveland-Stout at the Quincy Institute: "." LLM Poisoning In the examples above, users can at least trace the sources that chatbots are pulling from when they search websites directly, such as in the screenshots above. Infiltrating the training data itself, on the other hand, can lead to Israel-influenced responses that are nearly impossible for users to trace. To measure how deeply the network had penetrated the data used to train AI models, Drop Site used Claude Fable to query Common Crawl to count how often Parscale's sites appear in its monthly snapshots. According to that analysis, a sample of which was manually fact-checked by Drop Site, between January and June 10 sites were crawled by Common Crawl 912 times. While this is a drop in the bucket of Common Crawl data, emerging research suggests a very low number of documents can successfully manipulate AI chatbots, no matter the data volume. The 10 sites are: 1. (crawled 220 times): Website dedicated to showcasing the narrative that Israel is a nation of peace. "Paxpoint highlights Israel's ongoing commitment to peace and coexistence, sharing historical accords, humanitarian initiatives, and grassroots projects that bridge divides." 2. (crawled 158 times): Website dedicated to strengthening the U.S.-Israel alliance. "Allyvia showcases how the US and Israel alliance directly benefits Americans through joint security, cutting-edge technologies, job creation, and shared values of liberty." 3. (crawled 108 times): Mission is to "prove that Hamas' terrorist designation reflects global consensus and undeniable evidence of violence, not conspiracy" 4. (crawled 106 times): Website claims to be a "research and education platform" dedicated to exploring how extremist groups such as Hamas operate. 5. (crawled 93 times): Website dedicated to arguing that Israel's military actions in Gaza "follows international law and reflects the democratic ethics shared by the US and Israel." 6. (crawled 76 times): Website focused on celebrating cultural ties between U.S. and Israel. 7. (crawled 57 times): Website dedicated to sharing stories, data, and eyewitness accounts of "how Israel protects civilians, delivers humanitarian aid, and upholds moral values shared with the US." 8. (crawled 49 times): Website dedicated to highlighting U.S.-Israeli trade relationship. 9. (crawled 45 times): Website dedicated to highlighting U.S.-Israeli technology partnership. 10. (crawled 1 time): Website featuring videos that claim footage coming out Gaza is staged and denying famine. These sites are being crawled more and more. In January 2026, the sites were only crawled twice. In May, the sites were crawled 376 times, before a notable dip in June. To check the accuracy of Claude Fable, Drop Site manually searched for a sampling of 50 of the Clock Tower X URLs archived in Common Crawl's CDXJ index, and did not detect any errors. Clock Tower X's Pro-Israel Websites by Times Archived in Common Crawl (January-Present) Herve Letoqueux, Chief Executive Officer at Check First, an organization that combats digital disinformation, explained that Common Crawl's status as the go-to source for training chatbots opens it up as a target for manipulation. "Common Crawl is widely used in the world of data science for training LLMs, which also means that actors want to manipulate the answers in their favor, which some studies have indicated are fairly easy to do." It only takes about "250 malicious documents to produce a 'backdoor' vulnerability in a large language model--regardless of model size of training data volume," according to an October Anthropic . The authors of the study note "this means anyone can create online content that might eventually end up in a model's training data," and that malicious actors "can inject specific text into these posts to make a model learn undesirable or dangerous behaviours, in a process known as poisoning." The Atlantic Council's Digital Forensic Research Lab published a similar study earlier this year on Russia's disinformation network's attempts to influence LLMs and an important caveat. Because artificial intelligence companies have their own process of quality control when they incorporate data, "Inclusion in Common Crawl does not guarantee inclusion in any given model's training data." Drop Site also performed a demo alongside Letoqueux to test five different chatbots--Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Claude AI, and Perplexity--on whether they could produce articles using only their training data. Of the five, the Parscale network consistently appears in the training data of Gemini and Copilot. Claude and ChatGPT did not appear to contain the websites in the training data, though these chatbots can still search Clock Tower X websites when responding to queries. Perplexity, meanwhile, appeared to be trained on some of the Clock Tower X websites. Microsoft Copilot and Google Gemini did not respond to a request for comment for this article. 'It is easy to prove that these models were trained on the Clock Tower X websites, though it is difficult to know the degree to which that influences the response a chatbot gives to a query,' said Letoqueux. Optimizing for AI Parscale's team has credited their success with a softer approach to selling Israel's narrative. Scott Stouffer, Chief Technology Officer of Market Brew--a company that specializes in influencing LLMs that Parscale invests in-- Axios that information written in a "factual tone and tightly organized" is more likely to be cited in AI platforms. "What you can do is make sure that your information is structured, sourced, and aligned in a way that those systems are more likely to retrieve it when someone asks a question. It's less about changing the conversation and more about making sure your facts are eligible to be part of it." Many of the blog posts on the Clock Tower network contain at least a few sentences of nuance, which disinformation researchers say make it more palatable for chatbots. For instance, the FactSignal blog post about how journalists in Gaza are supposedly secret terrorists states that, "Distinguishing between legitimate reporters and militant operatives is not always simple, but accurate reporting requires careful investigation and transparency." The author of many of the blog posts is Israel-based digital marketer Mark Ginsberg, according to the source code. Ginsberg, who registered as a foreign agent for Israel in March, his expertise in Generative Engine Optimization--or LLM grooming--on his Linkedin profile. In a June for The Times of Israel, Ginsberg laid out the argument for Israel investing in efforts to influence chatbots. "Israel needs to invest seriously in the defense of truth...It means ensuring that accurate information appears not merely in government archives but in search results, educational resources, encyclopedias, social media feeds, podcasts, documentaries, and AI training datasets," Ginsberg wrote. Trying to influence AI training data, Ginsberg argued, is not "embracing disinformation" but rather stating "reality itself." Letoqueux, who reviewed the Clock Tower network sites, confirmed that because chatbots have a built-in preference for presenting a balanced view, websites that are sourced and present a lighter touch might be more successful. "These websites could probably be quite useful at doing damage control on questions such as 'Is Israel committing a genocide?' because they provide the Israeli narrative, which chatbots can then repeat as representative of one side of the debate," said Letoqueux, who is the former head of operations at VIGINUM, the French agency responsible for identifying foreign digital interference. Alice Lee, an analyst at NewsGuard, a disinformation tracking company, explained in an interview with Drop Site that the Parscale network sites have all the hallmarks of sites that would be successful at influencing chatbots. "The websites have bullet points, key takeaways at the top of the page, aggressive sourcing, digestible information, all of which increase the likelihood that this content is picked up by AI chatbots." While Russia's Pravda network overall is far larger, Parscale's sites have a far higher rate of successfully being archived. The Clock Tower network contains 900 different pathways--individual blog posts, fact sheets, etc--and 85% of them have been archived in Common Crawl, compared to Russia's network at an of around 2.5%. Lee, who specializes in Russian disinformation, explained that whereas Russia is churning out easily debunkable propaganda at scale, Israel's more targeted approach appears to be geared more toward conveying the Israeli narrative on half-truths, opinions, and disputed facts, which is more difficult for LLMs to dismiss. "It's harder to put guardrails around opinion," she explained. Parscale appears to have created several other websites related to Qatar that did not end up being published. On the same IP address as the Clock Tower network, Drop Site identified domains for websites including "qataritracker.org" and "." These sites are currently inaccessible. The Clock Tower network is responsive to Israel's shifting priorities. When the sites first launched in October, many of them posted frequently about how Israel is a peaceful nation. "While critics portray Israel as resistant to compromise, history shows the opposite: Israel has repeatedly made territorial and strategic concessions in exchange for peace, only to face renewed hostility," reads one published in October, cited by Microsoft Copilot below. That page was archived by Common Crawl twice. | | ---|---|--- Screenshot of Copilot citing a Clock Tower X site. Part of this effort included shaping the narrative over Israel's military actions in Gaza. For instance, a page on titled "How Israel Reduces Civilian Harm in War Against Hamas and Hezbollah" claims that Israel went above and beyond international legal requirements to reduce civilian harm. The post says that Israel "used short warning strikes on rooftops, known as roof knocking, to signal imminent danger without causing casualties." The New York Times has that Israel "significantly reduced its use of so-called roof knocks" from the first day of the war, and has often opted for 2,000 pound bombs that cause greater damage rather than more precise munitions. That post has been archived by Common Crawl once, and is also cited below by Perplexity. | | ---|---|--- Screenshot of Perplexity citing from a Clock Tower X site. Most recently, as debate in the U.S. erupted over a Congressional measure that could further intertwine the U.S. and Israeli military sectors, the Clock Tower network published a of framing the move as a positive development. The House version of Section 219, as it's known, passed as part of the annual defense spending bill this week. When Drop Site asked prominent chatbots a question containing similar language from of the Parscale sites, "how does technology collaboration between the U.S. and Israel benefit both nations?" Gemini, Copilot, and Perplexity once again cited websites from the Clock Tower network without noting these sources are created on behalf of the Israeli government. | | ---|---|--- Screenshot of Gemini citing a Clock Tower X site. | | ---|---|--- Screenshot of Copilot citing two Clock Tower X sites. $4.5 Million a Month Public opinion of Israel has cratered in the U.S. after its U.S.-funded military siege of Gaza has over 70,000 Palestinians, across key demographics such as conservatives and evangelicals that have long supported the U.S.-Israel relationship. According to a new Quincy Institute by the author of this article, Israel has spent well-over $100 million on foreign lobbying efforts under FARA in the U.S. since 2023, hiring 17 new firms in 2024 and 2025 alone. Although Israel has historically avoided hiring official contractors under FARA, it is now on track to become the largest single spender in 2026. Parscale, who gained national attention as Trump's campaign manager for hiring the controversial microtargetting firm Cambridge Analytica, is the largest recipient of Israel's massive influence investment. body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136160964/636550395/-1066975755?refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.07.28_jackson-split_B1_F1_S1_C1_120DO150DC150DD_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0OTZhZjlmNi1hOThhLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dKOzfCjltyhQFRkGmcIgCwKN3RtcvT6irAoj24eCzzI=) Folks,

Growing up in Allagash and spending years working 80-hour weeks in the woods to make ends meet, I know firsthand what working Mainers need from our government.

And for 30 years, Susan Collins has failed us. Time and again, she has sold us out to Donald Trump and his MAGA agenda while pretending we’re too dumb to notice. **And I’m sick of it. **

My name is Troy Jackson. I’m a proud Mainer, father, and fifth-generation logger.

[**_Last weekend, I officially earned the Democratic nomination for U.S. Senate. Now it’s time to defeat Susan Collins and her billionaire backers. So I’m asking you to split a donation between my campaign and Kirsten Gillibrand to become a Founding Donor to my campaign right now and help us win the most important Senate race in the country. _**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136160965/636550396/-1066975755?refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.07.28_jackson-split_B1_F1_S1_C1_120DO150DC150DD_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0OTZhZjlmNi1hOThhLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dKOzfCjltyhQFRkGmcIgCwKN3RtcvT6irAoj24eCzzI=) | | [ CHIP IN NOW >> ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136160966/636550397/-1066975755?refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.07.28_jackson-split_B1_F1_S1_C1_120DO150DC150DD_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0OTZhZjlmNi1hOThhLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dKOzfCjltyhQFRkGmcIgCwKN3RtcvT6irAoj24eCzzI=)
---
Let me tell you a bit about what this race means to me.

When I was growing up, I was a poor kid in a town full of poor kids. My family relied on food assistance at times. I distinctly remember when I was 13 years old, we didn’t have heat or running water, and I heard my mother quietly crying to herself, wishing she could do more for us.

After high school, I became a logger like my dad, and his dad, and his dad before him. When a greedy landowner tried to screw my fellow loggers and me out of fair wages, I fought back. A whole bunch of politicians, including then-first-term Senator Susan Collins, promised to listen, but they left us high and dry — and I realized that _nothing would change_ unless there were working-class voices in power.

So I ran for the Maine legislature, where I served 20 years, including six years as the President of the Maine Senate. It’s been the honor of my life to fight for working people.

I drove hours each way between the North Woods and the State Capitol, because that's what the job required. I won those elections in a district that went for Trump by 20 points, because up here, people care less about a label and more about whether you give a damn about their family.

I’m building this campaign the right way. With grassroots support from folks like you. I’m not running to impress the billionaires or the corporate class. I’m running for the mom who’s worried about how she’ll fill her gas tank this week. I’m running for the kid whose whole life will be determined by the quality of his education. I’m running to ensure every working family in Maine has the government they deserve.

[**_If you believe in this fight and our movement, I’m humbly asking you to split a donation between my campaign and Kirsten Gillibrand today to help us reach our fundraising goal and take on the GOP’s millions. Even $5 makes a difference >> _**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136160967/636550398/-1066975755?amount=5&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.07.28_jackson-split_B1_F1_S1_C1_120DO150DC150DD_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0OTZhZjlmNi1hOThhLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dKOzfCjltyhQFRkGmcIgCwKN3RtcvT6irAoj24eCzzI=)

clean_body: = Folks, Growing up in Allagash and spending years working 80-hour weeks in the woods to make ends meet, I know firsthand what working Mainers need from our government. And for 30 years, Susan Collins has failed us. Time and again, she has sold us out to Donald Trump and his MAGA agenda while pretending we’re too dumb to notice. And I’m sick of it. My name is Troy Jackson. I’m a proud Mainer, father, and fifth-generation logger. = | | = Let me tell you a bit about what this race means to me. When I was growing up, I was a poor kid in a town full of poor kids. My family relied on food assistance at times. I distinctly remember when I was 13 years old, we didn’t have heat or running water, and I heard my mother quietly crying to herself, wishing she could do more for us. After high school, I became a logger like my dad, and his dad, and his dad before him. When a greedy landowner tried to screw my fellow loggers and me out of fair wages, I fought back. A whole bunch of politicians, including then-first-term Senator Susan Collins, promised to listen, but they left us high and dry — and I realized that nothing would change unless there were working-class voices in power. So I ran for the Maine legislature, where I served 20 years, including six years as the President of the Maine Senate. It’s been the honor of my life to fight for working people. I drove hours each way between the North Woods and the State Capitol, because that's what the job required. I won those elections in a district that went for Trump by 20 points, because up here, people care less about a label and more about whether you give a damn about their family. I’m building this campaign the right way. With grassroots support from folks like you. I’m not running to impress the billionaires or the corporate class. I’m running for the mom who’s worried about how she’ll fill her gas tank this week. I’m running for the kid whose whole life will be determined by the quality of his education. I’m running to ensure every working family in Maine has the government they deserve. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Troy Jackson and Kirsten Gillibrand will go through immediately: | = | = | = | = | = In solidarity with you always, Troy Jackson * A message from DSCC Chair Kirsten Gillibrand: =

# [Trump just revealed the US sold over $13 billion in Venezuela oil](https://substack.com/redirect/dd72de9d-2ff1-4f8c-b869-b9ade2c11782?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
President Donald Trump said Monday that **[the U.S. has collected more than $13 billion from the sale of Venezuelan crude oil](https://substack.com/redirect/210516be-f542-42e8-8e5d-c9efed475cf2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** since capturing former President Nicolas Maduro in a January military raid.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dd72de9d-2ff1-4f8c-b869-b9ade2c11782?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Oil funds Venezuela operations:** Trump told reporters aboard Air Force One the money is used to run Venezuela and has paid for that war many times over with billions collected.
* **Continuous KPMG auditing process:** Secretary of State Marco Rubio told Congress the oil sales are audited by KPMG on every expenditure with money held in a Citibank account.
* **150 million barrels sold:** Energy Secretary Chris Wright said in an April interview the U.S. had sold around 150 million barrels of Venezuelan oil since January.
* **Disbursements for approved uses:** Official Michael Kozak said around $3 billion was disbursed from the Treasury account for worker salaries, oil industry supplies and other approved uses.

# [Apple just dethroned Nvidia as the world's most valuable company](https://substack.com/redirect/dd72de9d-2ff1-4f8c-b869-b9ade2c11782?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Apple passed Nvidia on Monday for **[the title of world's most valuable company](https://substack.com/redirect/d4676ec9-90ed-4d64-a0a8-3af43f32442f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with the iPhone maker topping the AI chip firm at market close for the first time since April 2025.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dd72de9d-2ff1-4f8c-b869-b9ade2c11782?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Close of day valuations:** Nvidia shares fell 5% giving the chipmaker a valuation of $4.77 trillion while Apple shares rose 1% for a market cap of $4.95 trillion ahead of earnings.
* **Prior top spot timeline:** Nvidia held the top spot as the most valuable company since June 2025 when it took the crown from Microsoft and briefly held a $5 trillion capitalization in October.
* **Year to date contrast:** So far in 2026 Nvidia's shares have only climbed 4% while Apple's are up 24% as investors reward its reluctance to spend heavily on AI capital expenditures.
* **Upcoming earnings details:** Apple will report fiscal third-quarter earnings on Thursday expected to reveal financial impacts from the AI-driven global memory chip shortage that forced Mac and iPad price raises in June.

# [SK Hynix plunges as the global semiconductor selloff turns into a bloodbath](https://substack.com/redirect/dd72de9d-2ff1-4f8c-b869-b9ade2c11782?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
South Korean **[semiconductor shares tumbled on Tuesday](https://substack.com/redirect/e9e6ea6a-b615-4a14-b2ce-46a024b892e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with SK Hynix closing 14.65% lower and Samsung Electronics losing more than 13%, extending a rout after weak Wall Street sessions.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dd72de9d-2ff1-4f8c-b869-b9ade2c11782?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Major US chip declines:** Nvidia ticked 1% lower while Intel sank 8%, AMD fell 10%, Micron dropped 11% and Sandisk lost 17% in the selloff.
* **Asia Pacific heavy losses:** Tokyo Electron dropped 10.96%, Advantest slid over 10%, SoftBank Group fell 4.43% and Japan's Kioxia plunged more than 18%.
* **Europe follows chip weakness:** ASML shares fell more than 8% Monday after reports of Chinese immersion deep ultraviolet lithography machine production in its dominated area.
* **Investor AI cycle doubts:** Analysts cited uncertainty over the AI investment cycle, leveraged ETFs adding volatility and broker reports on memory prices peaking in 2027 as selloff drivers.

SpaceX erased more than $1.2 trillion in market cap since its June high of $225.64, **[nearly the full value of Tesla,](https://substack.com/redirect/aa141bc0-00a3-42aa-b774-7051c19bb13c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/aa141bc0-00a3-42aa-b774-7051c19bb13c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)after shares fell to $113.50 in 13 of 16 sessions Monday.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dd72de9d-2ff1-4f8c-b869-b9ade2c11782?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Market cap plunge deepens:** SpaceX shares shed more than 1% Monday ending at $113.50 and continued lower about 3% in early Tuesday trading after the prolonged selloff.
* **Options activity shows balance:** Traders bought 106,000 calls versus 77,000 puts on Monday though the majority of the $442 million premium was tied to puts including popular long-shot contracts.
* **Large trades lean bullish:** Four of five biggest premium trades were neutral or bullish including multimillion-dollar in-the-money put spread sales that require SpaceX to rally higher.
* **Lockup expiration looms ahead:** First post-IPO earnings report next week allows sale of 20% of eligible locked-up stock totaling up to 911.5 million shares starting August 6.

* * *
* * *
# [Ford just stormed into an Army truck race that could be worth billions](https://substack.com/redirect/dd72de9d-2ff1-4f8c-b869-b9ade2c11782?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Ford Motor Co. is pursuing what **[could be its biggest military contract in decades](https://substack.com/redirect/5cf2c10d-e993-48e5-97e2-3407f4dbfbd3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/5cf2c10d-e993-48e5-97e2-3407f4dbfbd3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)competing to build a new tactical truck for the U.S. Army based on F-Series Super Duty prototypes.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dd72de9d-2ff1-4f8c-b869-b9ade2c11782?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Prototype contract secured Monday:** The automaker secured a Department of War contract to develop three prototypes based on its F-Series Super Duty pickups as reported by The Wall Street Journal.
* **Spokesperson emphasizes extreme durability:** A Ford spokesperson said Super Duty trucks are engineered for extreme durability and demanding conditions making them an ideal platform for military use with global parts support.
* **Joins GM and BC Customs:** Ford competes alongside General Motors which unveiled a similar prototype in 2024 now undergoing field testing and Utah-based BC Customs LLC which also received a prototype contract.
* **Largest since the Cold War:** The program could represent Ford's largest military vehicle opportunity since the Cold War as some governments already use Ford vehicles for military transport and security.

# [Jersey Mike's IPO demand explodes past 10 times available shares](https://substack.com/redirect/dd72de9d-2ff1-4f8c-b869-b9ade2c11782?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Jersey Mike's Subs initial public offering **[attracted investor demand for more than 10 times the available shares](https://substack.com/redirect/f10fac0d-35d4-47b5-aeb6-438be2f56b17?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** ahead of pricing on Wednesday as the chain looks to raise as much as $1.09 billion.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dd72de9d-2ff1-4f8c-b869-b9ade2c11782?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Offering size and price:** The IPO consists of about 43.5 million shares for $21 to $25 each including approximately 29.7 million shares offered by backers including Blackstone and Abu Dhabi Investment Authority.
* **Implied market valuation:** At the top of the range Jersey Mike's would have a market value of nearly $8 billion based on the outstanding shares listed in its SEC filing.
* **Locations and ownership:** Jersey Mike's has more than 3,300 locations in the US and Canada after Blackstone bought a majority stake in 2024 for about $8 billion including debt.
* **Trading debut details:** Shares are expected to begin trading on the New York Stock Exchange on July 30 under the symbol JMKE with Morgan Stanley Jefferies and JPMorgan leading the IPO.

# [Tech wealth turns prehistoric fossils into the hottest status symbols](https://substack.com/redirect/dd72de9d-2ff1-4f8c-b869-b9ade2c11782?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Major **[auction houses racked up nearly $10 billion in sales in the first half of 2026](https://substack.com/redirect/43f6a875-6f88-4f69-a1d1-ae91b64a7eb4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/43f6a875-6f88-4f69-a1d1-ae91b64a7eb4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)marking one of the strongest-ever starts as tech wealth from AI boom and IPOs drives record prices across categories.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dd72de9d-2ff1-4f8c-b869-b9ade2c11782?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Sotheby 's and Christie's records:** Sotheby's reported its best first half ever with $4.4 billion in sales up 58% while Christie's had its best since 2021 with $4.5 billion up 71%.
* **Top lots break records:** Eight lots sold for more than $50 million including a Jackson Pollock painting for $181 million and a Brancusi sculpture for $107.6 million previously owned by S.I. Newhouse.
* **Watches and dinosaur bones:** Phillips reported $235 million in watch auctions with an F.P. Journe piece at $13.9 million while Sotheby's sold T. rex fossil "Gus" for $50.1 million the most expensive ever.
* **Young tech collectors rise:** 30% of Christie's buyers were new with 47% millennials or younger and 85% of bids online as younger tech money redefines collectibles from cars to jackets.

body:
With less than 100 days until November, we don’t have a moment to waste.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260728-1&t=1&akid=3782%2E587540%2EydzTlR)
Peter,
I was on CNN last night talking about the chaos unfolding this week at the Democratic National Committee.
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260728_1_cnn.uQ-C6T&refcode=em20260728-3782&t=2&akid=3782%2E587540%2EydzTlR)
Here’s what I had to say: **DNC Chair Ken Martin has got to go.**
The DNC is completely dysfunctional under his leadership. If we want to build a party that is actually capable of winning back the voters we lost in 2024 and defeating Trumpism, _we have to start telling hard truths._
**[If you’re with me, add your name to this petition demanding Ken Martin resign as DNC Chair now.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/sign/lwd-em20260728-ken-martin/?source=em20260728-3782&t=3&akid=3782%2E587540%2EydzTlR)**
**[Add Your Name »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/sign/lwd-em20260728-ken-martin/?source=em20260728-3782&t=4&akid=3782%2E587540%2EydzTlR)**
Ken Martin ran on releasing a full autopsy report to hold the party accountable and lay out a real strategy for winning back voters we lost in 2024. **Instead, he spent months making excuses — claiming the biggest problem at the DNC was _me_ calling for real change inside the party. **
And when the autopsy finally came out, it was a joke. It ignored core issues eroding our party and driving young voters away including. It had no mentions of Gaza, inflation, or President Biden’s age.
On top of that, **the DNC is now $2M in debt.** Their primary job is to raise money, and Ken Martin can’t even manage to do that.
This is a moment we can’t afford to waste. We lost to Trump for a second time — we cannot in good conscience go back to voters pretending _nothing_ needs to change.
We have to do more than swap out talking points and roll out the same establishment insiders who have been running this party into the ground for decades.
**That’s the entire reason we built Leaders We Deserve.** We’re backing bold, forward-thinking leaders who have the urgency, courage, and moral clarity this moment demands. Leaders with a backbone who aren’t afraid to take on tough fights and deliver for the communities they come from. Leaders who reject the corporate special interests trying to buy them off.
If we want a party that truly fights for our future, can defeat Trump and MAGA extremism, and will restore trust and hope in young voters — we need leadership that is accountable, transparent, and reliable. **It’s clear that leadership will not come from Ken Martin.**
**[Will you add your name to this petition demanding Ken Martin resigns as DNC chair today?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/sign/lwd-em20260728-ken-martin/?source=em20260728-3782&t=5&akid=3782%2E587540%2EydzTlR)**
**[Add Your Name »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/sign/lwd-em20260728-ken-martin/?source=em20260728-3782&t=6&akid=3782%2E587540%2EydzTlR)**
Thank you,

body:
The moral foundation of our country matters now more than ever.

| | | | | | | [VIEW THIS EMAIL IN BROWSER](https://mailchi.mp/31b796ad46c1/to-my-dad-on-fathers-day-2375649?e=3cb50a0604)
