| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |
Our Rights Do Not Come From Government
---
| |
Friend,
Our rights do not come from Washington.
They do not come from Congress, a president, or a political party.
**Our rights come from God.**
The Ten Commandments gave people a clear moral framework for living together: honor God, respect life, protect the family, tell the truth, and do not take what belongs to someone else.
Those principles became part of the moral foundation of Western civilization.America’s Founders understood that freedom could not survive without truth, personal responsibility, and a people willing to govern themselves.
They also understood that government does not create our rights.Government is supposed to protect the rights God has already given us.That belief is at the heart of our constitutional republic.
The First Amendment prevents the government from establishing an official religion while also protecting the free exercise of faith. It does not require Christians to hide their beliefs or remove faith from public life.
But today, too many people act as though faith has no place in our schools, communities, government, or public conversations.
When we remove God and objective truth from society, right and wrong begin to depend on who holds power.
Rights become privileges handed out by government.
And anything government gives can eventually be taken away.
That is why this issue matters.
**Liberty cannot survive without responsibility.**
**Law cannot remain just when truth becomes optional.**
**Government cannot be trusted to define the rights it was created to protect.**
I believe Christians should never be afraid to bring their faith into the public square.
We should speak the truth.
We should serve our neighbors.
We should defend religious liberty.
We should vote according to our convictions.
And we should elect leaders who understand that the Constitution is not a suggestion.I am running for Congress because I believe South Alabama deserves a representative who will defend the Constitution, protect religious freedom, and remember that government works for the people.
I will not leave my faith at the door when I go to Washington.
I will look at every issue through the principles of the Bible and the Constitution.Our nation’s future depends on leaders who know where our rights come from and have the courage to defend them.
Will you stand with me?
DONATE TODAY

Forward this message with your family and friends.
Vote Austin Sidwell on August 11.
Faith. Family. Freedom.
Austin Sidwell

clean_body: The moral foundation of our country matters now more than ever. | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Our Rights Do Not Come From Government | | Friend, Our rights do not come from Washington. They do not come from Congress, a president, or a political party. Our rights come from God. The Ten Commandments gave people a clear moral framework for living together: honor God, respect life, protect the family, tell the truth, and do not take what belongs to someone else. Those principles became part of the moral foundation of Western civilization.America’s Founders understood that freedom could not survive without truth, personal responsibility, and a people willing to govern themselves. They also understood that government does not create our rights.Government is supposed to protect the rights God has already given us.That belief is at the heart of our constitutional republic. The First Amendment prevents the government from establishing an official religion while also protecting the free exercise of faith. It does not require Christians to hide their beliefs or remove faith from public life. But today, too many people act as though faith has no place in our schools, communities, government, or public conversations. When we remove God and objective truth from society, right and wrong begin to depend on who holds power. Rights become privileges handed out by government. And anything government gives can eventually be taken away. That is why this issue matters. Liberty cannot survive without responsibility. Law cannot remain just when truth becomes optional. Government cannot be trusted to define the rights it was created to protect. I believe Christians should never be afraid to bring their faith into the public square. We should speak the truth. We should serve our neighbors. We should defend religious liberty. We should vote according to our convictions. And we should elect leaders who understand that the Constitution is not a suggestion.I am running for Congress because I believe South Alabama deserves a representative who will defend the Constitution, protect religious freedom, and remember that government works for the people. name: Eric Holder Jr.
subject: Throwing my support behind Gina
body:
I’ll be honest, Peter.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260728_2_holder.JquxeS&refcode=em20260728-1679&amount=5&t=1&akid=1679%2E299639%2EpBXhgH)
Peter,
I’ve spent much of my career fighting to protect the foundations of our democracy — from defending voting rights as the 82nd Attorney General of the United States to working to protect the voice of the people in elections across the country.
Through my experience, I've learned that the fights that matter most for the future of our nation often happen at the state level. And to be honest, the stakes in Texas right now couldn’t be higher.
Republicans recently got the Supreme Court decision they wanted, severely weakening key protections from the Voting Rights Act that historically helped communities of color fight back against rigged maps. **Now, Greg Abbott has made it clear that he will use every single move he has in his pocket to redraw district lines and lock in power for Republicans.**
We need you to understand exactly what this means for the future of our country. Before I explain, **[will you make a $5 donation to Gina Hinojosa’s campaign today to ensure she is elected this November and can finally put an end to this corruption?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260728_2_holder.JquxeS&refcode=em20260728-1679&amount=5&t=2&akid=1679%2E299639%2EpBXhgH)**
Texas is growing at a rapid pace. By the next census, the state is projected to gain 4 to 5 more congressional seats, drawing political power away from states like California and New York. This means Texas is going to carry even more weight in the House and the electoral college.
If Republicans hold on to unchecked control of Texas through 2030, they’ll draw maps so extreme that it will become nearly impossible for Democrats to win a majority in Congress and even more difficult to win the White House.
**_That is why this governor’s race is so important._**
**We must elect governors who have the courage to veto these rigged, anti-democratic maps.** If Texans elect Gina, she will stand as a vital roadblock against partisan overreach, stopping the next Republican gerrymandering stunt before it happens and protecting a fair playing field for the entire country.
I am proudly throwing my support behind Gina because she is the real deal, and she is ready to fight for a Texas where _every_ community is fairly represented.
**[But she can’t do it alone. Peter, will you chip in $5 today to help elect Gina and bring true leadership back to Texas?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260728_2_holder.JquxeS&refcode=em20260728-1679&amount=5&t=3&akid=1679%2E299639%2EpBXhgH)**

Thank you,
Eric H. Holder, Jr.
82nd United States Attorney General

clean_body: | = I wanted to reach out to you personally about the state of our race. = | | = What’s happening in the Palmetto State is truly unprecedented. There hasn't been an open Senate seat in 23 years. Back in 2003, when I was still in med school and flared jeans were all the rage, South Carolina actually had a Democratic Senator. And that’s what we’re aiming for again in 2026 – a Democratic Senator to fight for all of you. But let me be clear: our campaign just entered a brand-new, uncharted phase. While we don’t know our opponent yet, what we do know is whoever they are, they're starting at $0, which means Republicans are chomping at the bit to pour as much money as possible into keeping this seat red. Bad news today, Team.
A federal appeals court ruled today that the Trump administration may continue implementing President Donald Trump’s anti-mail voting executive order . The U.S. Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia affirmed a lower court’s decision, holding that a lawsuit challenging the constitutionality of Trump’s March 2026 edict was premature because the administration hasn’t executed it yet.
This is a different case from the U.S. Supreme Court's recent ruling on counting mail-in ballots received after Election Day . That case, Watson V. RNC , ended with rational minds choosing to count ballots that were mailed on time.
This case is different: Trump's Executive Order from March 2026 ordered the U.S. Postal Service (USPS) to send mail ballots in new barcoded envelopes only to voters on citizenship lists compiled by the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) and the Social Security Administration. After defenders of voting rights quickly sued, a U.S. District Court Judge denied the preliminary injunction back in May, saying it would be premature to issue it when the federal agencies hadn’t begun implementation yet. The appeal of that ruling is what was decided today.
It's worth noting that both courts said the case was "premature," which means that no voter had yet been harmed by the order, so the court was unable to rule on the merits of the case. This means that neither court made any decision on the merits of the case brought to protect mail-in ballots.
Listen, we know this is a lot of information, Team. The long and short of it is that we need your help to keep standing up to this Executive Order and protect mail-in voting. # Friend,
---
Just days ago, independent journalist **Nick Shirley** walked into the California State Capitol with a camera and confronted the Democrat lawmakers who are trying to silence him. Most of them scattered. The few who stayed had no real answers. _Why the panic?_ Because California Democrats are fast-tracking **AB 2624** -- already being called the **" Stop Nick Shirley Act."** This bill would make it a **crime** for citizen journalists like Nick to film or post videos of publicly funded facilities -- exactly the kind of on-the-ground investigative work Nick has been doing in California and Minnesota. If this bill passes, Nick's ability to expose taxpayer fraud in government programs could be severely crippled -- or even criminalized -- with fines up to $10,000 and forced content removal. Think about what that means:
---
* Nick's explosive Minnesota daycare fraud investigation that forced Congress to take notice?
* His on-the-ground reporting in California exposing waste and abuse in government programs?
* Future investigations into hospice fraud, voter roll issues, or any other taxpayer-funded facility?

---
**All of it could be criminalized under this new law.** The message from Sacramento Democrats is crystal clear: **" Stop exposing the fraud... ****_or we 'll make sure you can't."_** And the ultimate irony? The same lawmakers who authored and voted to advance this bill watched Nick Shirley walk right up to them in their own Capitol building, microphone in hand, and ask them point-blank why they're trying to criminalize investigative journalism. They had no good answer. **That 's why Lincoln Media Foundation exists -- and why we're asking for your help again today.** LMF is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit that **directly funds** independent journalists like Nick Shirley. We cover the real costs of his work -- travel, filming, editing, distribution, and security -- so he can keep investigating stories the mainstream media refuses to touch. Right now, your tax-deductible donation to LMF will go **toward supporting Nick Shirley** and protecting his ability to continue this critical work in the face of this new threat.

clean_body: California Democrats are fast-tracking a bill called the "Stop Nick Shirley Act" that threatens everything Nick and LMF are doing. | | | | | | | Friend, Just days ago, independent journalist Nick Shirley walked into the California State Capitol with a camera and confronted the Democrat lawmakers who are trying to silence him. Most of them scattered. The few who stayed had no real answers. Why the panic? Because California Democrats are fast-tracking AB 2624 -- already being called the " Stop Nick Shirley Act." This bill would make it a crime for citizen journalists like Nick to film or post videos of publicly funded facilities -- exactly the kind of on-the-ground investigative work Nick has been doing in California and Minnesota. If this bill passes, Nick's ability to expose taxpayer fraud in government programs could be severely crippled -- or even criminalized -- with fines up to $10,000 and forced content removal. Think about what that means: Nick's explosive Minnesota daycare fraud investigation that forced Congress to take notice? His on-the-ground reporting in California exposing waste and abuse in government programs? Future investigations into hospice fraud, voter roll issues, or any other taxpayer-funded facility? All of it could be criminalized under this new law. The message from Sacramento Democrats is crystal clear: " Stop exposing the fraud... **or we 'll make sure you can't." And the ultimate irony? The same lawmakers who authored and voted to advance this bill watched Nick Shirley walk right up to them in their own Capitol building, microphone in hand, and ask them point-blank why they're trying to criminalize investigative journalism. They had no good answer. That 's why Lincoln Media Foundation exists -- and why we're asking for your help again today. LMF is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit that directly funds independent journalists like Nick Shirley. We cover the real costs of his work -- travel, filming, editing, distribution, and security -- so he can keep investigating stories the mainstream media refuses to touch. Right now, your tax-deductible donation to LMF will go toward supporting Nick Shirley and protecting his ability to continue this critical work in the face of this new threat. subject: ⏰ The Dream & Promise Act needs YOUR voice. Have your Reps heard from you yet?
body:
Working families are counting on you! | | | Peter, ******350,000 TPS holders are set to lose their protections!** Over 350,000 TPS holders from Haiti and Syria are losing their work permits. TPS allowed them to provide for their families and fulfill roles in healthcare, construction, and hospitality, the industries that keep our communities running. Now that protection is gone. This doesn't have to keep happening. The Dream & Promise Act would give over 4 million immigrant young people, DACA recipients, and TPS holders a clear pathway to citizenship. **We know that****TPS isn’t the only program under attack.** DACA is being dismantled through renewal delays that cost people their jobs. Federal agents have detained over 340 DACA recipients and deported at least 90 since the start of 2025. **There’s a real solution right now. Rep. Sylvia Garcia has filed a discharge petition on the Dream & Promise Act (H.R. 1589).** Here's how it works: 218 Members of Congress need to sign a discharge petition. Once they do, the bill skips leadership entirely and goes straight to a vote. We know thatTPS isn’t the only program under attack. DACA is being dismantled through renewal delays that cost people their jobs. Federal agents have detained over 340 DACA recipients and deported at least 90 since the start of 2025. There’s a real solution right now. Rep. Sylvia Garcia has filed a discharge petition on the Dream & Promise Act (H.R. 1589). Here's how it works: 218 Members of Congress need to sign a discharge petition. Once they do, the bill skips leadership entirely and goes straight to a vote. We know what stability looks like. It looks like a permanent pathway to citizenship. Congress has the power to keep our families and communities safe. unity, Aria and the UWD team | Follow us on: | | | | |

| | Last month, two young pastors in New England (both in their twenties) told me they wouldn’t support or participate in our gatherings unless I first got on a Zoom call with them.

Normally, I don’t have time for conversations like this—especially while on family vacation in Montana—but I found an hour because I thought we’d be talking about how to reach New England together. I imagined we’d strategize about evangelism, Jesus Marches, baptisms, and seeing revival spread across the birthplace of the Great Awakenings.

Instead, they had one demand.

They wanted me to make a public statement condemning Bethel Church over doctrinal issues and scandals that I have no involvement with and no leadership over.

clean_body: | | | | | | | Last month, two young pastors in New England (both in their twenties) told me they wouldn’t support or participate in our gatherings unless I first got on a Zoom call with them. When I made the decision to run, I knew the attacks would be relentless. I am confident in my decision because I know I am not standing alone. You have my back, and I have yours. Together, we are a firewall protecting our common sense decisions. Again, thank you for standing with me. I would not be where I am today without your support. Sincerely, Susan Collins | the only Republican Senator in a state Kamala Harris won, Senator Susan Collins is the Democrats' . This isn't just about politics; it's about protecting Mainers and building a firewall that Chuck Schumer's millions cannot breach. | Paid for by Collins for Senator P.O. Box 1096 Bangor, ME 04402 |

body:
Colorado’s newest coal plant hasn’t run since August 2025. A national report suggests why.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hey friends,
Want your full news breakdown? Listen to the Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
Here's a summary of today's top stories:
**🏔️ Here in Colorado...** Denver doctor Shimon Blau [qualified as an unaffiliated candidate](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for the 1st Congressional District after Democrat Melat Kiros's primary upset over longtime Rep. Diana DeGette. An Aurora ICE facility employee was arrested for allegedly shooting a protester amid tensions over blocked worker access; [police declined to address protections for harassed federal employees](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Xcel's Comanche 3 coal plant [remains offline after a turbine failure](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), mirroring a national rise in coal outages, with Colorado regulators citing unclear costs. A former Colorado conservative activist wrote that he and others turned down party leadership roles, citing the [personal toll of internal attacks](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) over any lack of talent.
**🇺🇸 On the National Stage...** Newly released Slack messages from Sen. Rand Paul's COVID-origins probe show "Proximal Origin" authors [privately called a lab leak "highly likely" before publicly ruling it out](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in March 2020. Separately, a GAO report finds [20 federal programs moving $1.1 trillion through states](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), including Medicaid and SNAP, are highly fraud-prone, with over $360 million in stolen SNAP benefits affecting 753,000+ households since 2022.
This is your Mountain Minute for Tuesday, July 28, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Colorado’s newest coal plant hasn’t run since August 2025. A national report suggests why.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Xcel Energy’s Comanche 3 power plant in Pueblo went offline on August 12, 2025, after elevated vibrations damaged the turbine. Nearly a year later, it still hasn’t produced a single watt.
According to Xcel’s most recent monthly report to state regulators in Proceeding 25V-0480E, filed July 22, the plant’s turbine rotor had to be shipped off-site for repair by Mitsubishi. The parts came back this summer. Workers are now in the middle of reassembling the unit. The company’s current estimate for return to service is mid-August 2026.
That’s twelve months offline for Colorado’s newest, largest coal plant, a 750-megawatt facility that cost $1.3 billion to build and runs about $34.5 million a year to operate.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[The candidates you never got to vote for](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY C. J. GARBO, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_A former Colorado political strategist explains why he — and a dozen other capable conservatives — turned down repeated calls to run for office._
* **Repeatedly recruited, repeatedly declined:** C.J. Garbo reveals he was asked over three years to run for Castle Rock Town Council, Douglas County Commissioner, State House, State Senate, and even State Party Chair, but turned every offer down despite believing he could have won and served well.
* **The math didn't work — not from lack of hours, but the toll:** Garbo says rebuilding the party's messaging and machinery is a real, achievable plan requiring 300-400 hours of work, but he concluded any such effort would be met not with honest debate but with character attacks and rumors that outrun any attempt to correct them.
* **A thin bench by choice, not chance:** He argues a dozen other talented conservatives ran the same calculation and reached the same conclusion, and that fixing the party requires protecting people's reputations after internal disagreements, defending the absent from rumors, and giving strategies real time to work.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[The Thriftiness Weapon: A-Tisket A-Tasket](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**BY DRAKE HUNTER | COMMENTARY | JULY 26** _A-tisket, a-tasket, a green and yellow basket. I wrote a letter to my love, and on the way I dropped it. Like most children, I never gave much thought to those words. I imagined a little girl happily skipping along with her colorful basket until, somewhere along the road, she accidentally dropped it. It wasn’t until years later that I realized the basket wasn’t really the tragedy. Baskets are replaceable. The real loss was what she was carrying. She dropped the letter to her love._ __
**[El Paso County sought election-security funds while the state sued over the conditions](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | JULY 24**
_While Colorado was preparing to challenge new federal election-security requirements in court, the election office in the state’s most populous county was moving ahead with plans to strengthen its own election security under the same grant program._
__
**[Colorado sues over Trump election rules tied to homeland security grants](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | JULY 23** _Colorado joined 24 other states and the District of Columbia on Thursday in suing the Trump administration over new rules that withhold a fifth of the state’s counterterrorism grant money unless Colorado shows it meets five federal election requirements._
__

**🧐 DID YOU KNOW?** Before it was Colorado, local gold miners in 1859 grew tired of waiting for the U.S. government to organize a local system. They simply invented their own illegal, unrecognized government called the "Jefferson Territory". They wrote a constitution, elected a governor, and collected taxes until Congress officially stepped in to create the Colorado Territory in 1861.

body:
[1]LeftNet

It’s Zohran Mamdani. A few months ago, we wound down our campaign
operations to focus on delivering results over the first few months of
this term.

We’re back.
Here’s why:

Progressives often use political campaigns as a tool to solely win (or
lose) elections. We build grassroots donor networks. We engage volunteers.
And come Election Day, we leave the campaign behind and start preparing to
govern. The emails stop coming.

But that is not how the big-money interests operate. Their work is
constant and prolific. In closed-door meetings, insider operatives
consider how to influence our politics year-round. That’s how our
opponents secured the resources to spend $83 million against our movement
last year.

There is a cynicism that our politics is permanently broken, that our
democracy can only favor the wealthy and well-connected. But I know that’s
not true. We just have to be willing to fight for it.

That’s why we’re making investments in our movement starting right now.

[ https://act.leftnet.org/go/22925?t=1001&akid=1690%2E2118727%2ERdAukX ]Will you sign up today so I can send you updates about how to help
defend our movement?

SIGN UP ››

We can expect that our opposition will be better funded, better organized,
and ready to spend earlier than before.

But now, we’re going to be ready.

By joining this movement, you’re helping us build an operation strong
enough to meet the fights ahead.

[ https://act.leftnet.org/go/22925?t=1002&akid=1690%2E2118727%2ERdAukX ]I would be incredibly grateful if you would join our campaign
today. 🙏🏽

In solidarity,

Zohran Mamdani

Paid for by Zohran for NYC 2029

name: Scott Wiener
subject: he spent nearly $10 million and still won’t quit
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Scott WIENER FOR CONGRESS
body:
| |

Hi Peter,

Saikat Chakrabarti spent nearly $10 million of his own money running for this seat. San Francisco voters rejected him. He finished third.

He is now funding a committee to elect my opponent. That *technically* follows the rules but only because centimillionaires like him have spent decades bending those rules to work for them.

**Elections should be decided by voters - not wealthy people looking for another way to tip the scales after losing._That’s wrong._

| There's a word that comes up a lot whenever unapologetic progressives run for office:
"Electability."
They tell us that drawing hard lines will cost us elections. That rejecting corporate PAC money is unrealistic, and that taking checks from powerful industries and groups like AIPAC is simply how serious candidates compete because voters barely know how campaigns work anyway.
But voters are noticing.
New polling is showing that Democrats backed by AIPAC, cryptocurrency interests, and pharmaceutical companies are performing significantly worse against Republicans than Democrats who rejected outside PAC money.
The biggest checks are no longer building the strongest campaigns.
People know those checks come with strings attached and that when corporations and billionaires spend millions putting someone in power, they expect that power to belong to them.
But campaigns like ours are refusing that bargain.
Our campaign rejected corporate PAC money and AIPAC influence, and thousands of people stepped forward to build something they were told couldn't win.
Together, we proved that their money isn't invincible, and when working people decide they have had enough, even the most powerful forces in politics can be beaten.
That choice helped us win. Now we have to prove our victory was only the beginning.

But campaigns like ours are refusing that bargain. Our campaign rejected corporate PAC money and AIPAC influence, and thousands of people stepped forward to build something they were told couldn't win. subject: One week left to replace an AIPAC stooge

body:
#
Peter,
We have just one week left until the Missouri primary on August 4th, and it comes down to one simple question: **Who should represent St. Louis — working people or AIPAC?**
_And while the choices in this primary are familiar, the path forward is clear._
Cori Bush has spent her career fighting for the people of MO-01. In Congress, she led the charge for a ceasefire in Gaza, slept on the steps of the Capitol to keep millions housed, led a statewide tour for reproductive justice after Missouri passed the most extreme abortion ban in the country, and never stopped fighting for Medicare for all and affordable housing — all while refusing corporate PAC money because she believes elected officials should stay accountable to their communities.
**That’s exactly why AIPAC and corporate super PACs are afraid of Cori, and are spending millions to stop her.** They’re afraid because she’s someone who refuses to fall in line. And if she returns to Congress, she’ll fight to dismantle the status quo that lets the establishment leave working people behind.
Meanwhile, Wesley Bell has shown exactly where his loyalties lie. After AIPAC’s network dropped $12 million to replace Cori with him in 2024, he has repeatedly sided with the pro-Israel lobby group funding his campaign instead of the people he represents.
He voted against an amendment to cut U.S. military funding to Israel, he criticized Cori’s calls for a ceasefire, and he accepted a luxury AIPAC-funded trip to Israel while families in St. Louis were struggling at home. And he still can’t call it a genocide. 3 years later.
**While Cori is accountable to the people, Bell is accountable to the wealthy donors who bought his seat.**
With just seven days until the Missouri primary, we have one last chance to prove that grassroots power is stronger than AIPAC, its super PACs, and its right-wing megadonors.

Justice Democrats

Most of them scattered. The few who stayed had no real answers. Why the panic? Because California Democrats are fast-tracking AB 2624 -- already being called the " Stop Nick Shirley Act." This bill would make it a crime for citizen journalists like Nick to film or post videos of publicly funded facilities -- exactly the kind of on-the-ground investigative work Nick has been doing in California and Minnesota. If this bill passes, Nick's ability to expose taxpayer fraud in government programs could be severely crippled -- or even criminalized -- with fines up to $10,000 and forced content removal. Think about what that means: Nick's explosive Minnesota daycare fraud investigation that forced Congress to take notice? His on-the-ground reporting in California exposing waste and abuse in government programs? Future investigations into hospice fraud, voter roll issues, or any other taxpayer-funded facility? All of it could be criminalized under this new law. The message from Sacramento Democrats is crystal clear: " Stop exposing the fraud... **or we 'll make sure you can't." And the ultimate irony? The same lawmakers who authored and voted to advance this bill watched Nick Shirley walk right up to them in their own Capitol building, microphone in hand, and ask them point-blank why they're trying to criminalize investigative journalism. They had no good answer. That 's why Lincoln Media Foundation exists -- and why we're asking for your help again today. You've seen
the videos — armed agents, masked faces, immigrants swept up in the
streets. But some of the worst damage is happening where you can’t see it:
inside the courtroom.

Immigration judges don't work for an independent court system. They work
for Trump's Department of Justice — and he's weaponizing it to fast-track
his mass deportation agenda.

These judges are using "master calendar" hearings, which used to be
routine check-ins. Under Trump, they've become accelerated mass hearings —
shoving as many cases through as fast as possible.

The trick is simple: reschedule someone's hearing with little notice. If
they miss it — even because the notice never reached them in time — a
judge orders them deported.

No hearing. No lawyer. No chance to say a word in their defense.

In Chicago, one judge recently pushed through 185 hearings in a single
sitting. Before Trump, that number was 20. And last month, two out of
every three deportation orders were decided this way nationwide.^1

This is Trump's design: weaponize the DOJ, rig the courts, make sure
people lose before they even walk in the door.

It's unconstitutional. And we're not having it. Demand Justice PAC is
exposing how Trump is turning the DOJ into a political weapon and fighting
for courts to operate independently, fairly, and beyond Trump's reach.

subject: Take back the libraries
body:
The antidote to Drag Queen Story Hour| | | | If you haven’t heard about the “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, please let me tell you why it’s so critical.
---
| | Fellow Conservative, If you haven’t heard about “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, _**[please let me tell you why it’s so critical.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=9c27c13fb89c4fe588aa82dbe70ede64&_e=4fuB50Fb-XXkJNPfw_VWBn4_l3EvFcj-WiEOxHeoCL--OLrWu4wvSzlgg_E3ze1w1lSpll29-bMDnSOL-8yYOrhuVxoE3rLpTmJ6y-1cMts1_5lqnI_ZbJIri8Dkb0EuCmwsGSbW2r9cUMIqMALh_0tSjPFQACFsVqh3xDm4eo9zm3SQDCs8OtPyizbhJrZ3XTHj2YgHs5Z4-P-m286AjL30tU_uRB0OmdHdEsnhFZDggITmaFNAi82Y-W99rUVv84sWjYD1fYSwFW7oZEUK_boAv_QqCxwv2iE57eLNboRO-x_12wVHkD4DN2L9FKVrxzJN03fOS8b4uyTHF7JQNTyTdtZcGxeAK18Sv6plr51odUac4aeDKCE_bViitDtEb6pvUkuYhjO3Aw4G4A9A4kqrOghthMyemJ_1YO2iTN4sD7XLry99azlQOu-07CQRLAFOdmo6hPjxPRTQwA1UwrStHIgHI6Fp6cGJkdoul93ViaFaJiOt8d0mPcFE17QELBL5lDvrQsSbAPnxtiHu1T9oPJNvMvlOH61-Jvef7GJyJCDLlRAklpzG61lAOFgmOVGeI8CJAe6Ild1c2NC0EUwz5lSIVcRuizLNi0cOzVZb51WyO2T8dUdsqTglGhyjAkdIDqUZToOmGgATjccpqNUDkfgrrbVWKzvl4nVOd-Shw10ojFndUVEYgq34_x9CL222NhDZH22eBbbWwAjWEw%3D%3D)**_ Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian.She would fill your mind with classics like _Pat the Bunny_ and _The Little Engine That Could_. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the _Three Musketeers_ , _Treasure Island_ and _Charlotte’s Web_.But today, all that has changed. Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and GLBTQR+ writers and voices.’ Radical librarians call _Adventures of Huckleberry Finn_ and _To Kill a Mockingbird_ “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic’ _Little House_ series.And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... _A is for Activist._ An _ABC_ _board_ _book_ for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for.” _Woke Baby_. “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.” _Prince and Knight._ The “premier queer-friendly fairy tale” about a prince who marries a knight instead of a princess. And _The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish._ A “family-friendly celebration of drag” that encourages children to “work it.”I wish I could tell you this was only happening in places like New York City and San Francisco...

| | _**[That’s why parents and grandparents across the country are rising up through See You At The Library Day.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=9c27c13fb89c4fe588aa82dbe70ede64&_e=4fuB50Fb-XXkJNPfw_VWBn4_l3EvFcj-WiEOxHeoCL--OLrWu4wvSzlgg_E3ze1w1lSpll29-bMDnSOL-8yYOrhuVxoE3rLpTmJ6y-1cMts1_5lqnI_ZbJIri8Dkb0EuCmwsGSbW2r9cUMIqMALh_0tSjPFQACFsVqh3xDm4eo9zm3SQDCs8OtPyizbhJrZ3XTHj2YgHs5Z4-P-m286AjL30tU_uRB0OmdHdEsnhFZDggITmaFNAi82Y-W99rUVv8XXGb6h-bBAdB-hDPry0jOPI8ePpesOjjP8IgdT7La8GlioPUSTRFy46R4Nspz8sAplly6oF-6I9A7TAmawUo4MUod9gqaivZyuQJKWOdarcyew3iWpuHgkhpz7f1y-XjsH9Trw7T001apZ65Tcd2H4TxuK5oaiD6IW5qz8fdDHaSIWnxd8co1U5DcWp2nClMB_p6R6H2WTij1i012Zw3rV90I7jaNnmfaye_LCK0Mw8KylAaFxwMryeKa0K_4-i1ziB9_bjGDJHtqfFhemmlgSehf7_dac54sdrx8lcR76Uvvj-TiPD7AX08atzkSfcKvPWRRsJPqj_vM0UGqZOtTmUs77bRlYBYata0DNIO-_dNcjpE0G7H8PztQ-68mGycTFJkGWMHeKOGnY1c8o2VZV8a_4H3qHyM295HRcDX8k6XDILT7-Qo59k0UunKxCFqaHOZXDeenUXOpPKZCvFpA%3D%3D)**_ For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA.And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content.Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating ‘the environment’ to a type of religion. Or maybe you’ve noticed the “Teen Zone” which is really meant to be a “parent-free” zone.The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: _Rick_ about a cross-dressing Grandpa, _Melissa_ filled with graphic nudity, and _Darkstalker_ featuring gory violence and domestic abuse.But here’s what’s really alarming. We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.”That may be good for your family -- for now.But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of _other_ children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values!_**[I hope you see why I need your help today.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=9c27c13fb89c4fe588aa82dbe70ede64&_e=4fuB50Fb-XXkJNPfw_VWBn4_l3EvFcj-WiEOxHeoCL--OLrWu4wvSzlgg_E3ze1w1lSpll29-bMDnSOL-8yYOrhuVxoE3rLpTmJ6y-1cMts1_5lqnI_ZbJIri8Dkb0EuCmwsGSbW2r9cUMIqMALh_0tSjPFQACFsVqh3xDm4eo9zm3SQDCs8OtPyizbhJrZ3XTHj2YgHs5Z4-P-m286AjL30tU_uRB0OmdHdEsnhFZDggITmaFNAi82Y-W99rUVvYUwAHJX6TFam5vOF7icsbe4JrZsuds6FbGzOTQZ-FBJiUqdzgdGWEWITLM_EuMe73PuqVJo8bxjGEMzhc7pkUE33-eYy4RN5fEsS0u5iOndCZ_c0me2OE0AmZRSJuRPzqnF86lXHl2SqLFmTZfjn8AKj92cjpNKXUpkY7ajz_OJPKym24XBCOmkxPb_xufupdqd6TwUAfvP0zyI_OuKpyhY4l4yiUvpC5wNSJMp-VrFvcLw0kQlMly_KvNeWNuhLsvlji6Uqlhhu5-0WlYwFETe0y1lP5T3QIqdG0ZlpuvaC6WH1FkKQUplSfGYGasAByYLTkokAOhqcOQX5rmucLpBlI0feqgNnWnhi7u0aDwTtMcyyL5fmxFBActZQwVPKqgFjHJ42oomGBHNs8o90PbUiKWq1bPoaW_9ZciQV9VBYOnAi_dW0fNeU7fWHBLHlSWOajFhiydWUH2pQKBWsXQ%3D%3D) **_My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.”I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood.But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian.When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action.So, I wrote a little book called “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit.Then I decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with _conservative Story Hours_ filled with the classic books you and I grew up with, plus new wholesome books like mine that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism.And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that onebit.>> Over 50 libraries rejected my request to host our Story Hour.>> The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep me out including booking all the event rooms for themselves. >> Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), my publisher was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on.I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile. In the end I got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States.And thousands of parents and grandparents brought their little ones to those “Story Hours” where we pledged allegiance to the flag, sang “God Bless America”, and read wholesome and Godly books.It was incredible. But here’s the greatest part...From there, parents and grandparents started asking how they could host “Story Hours” of their own.And that’s how the nationwide “See You at the Library” movement was born.Last year, committed conservatives just like you booked event rooms at 201 libraries in 46 states. body:

# One Week Away
---
| |
## _Join us on the campaign trail to keep the momentum going_
---
| | **Dear Peter,**
**I know it’s hard to believe, but Election Day is one week from tomorrow! With the end in sight, I wanted to take a moment to thank you from the bottom of my heart for believing in me, this movement, and in a better future for all of us.**
**We’ll be traversing the community turnout out every last voters for these final few days. On Wednesday, I’ll be participating in a**[**protest outside Rob Wittman’s Yorktown office**](https://us.list-manage.com/kmJz9JiQ2bc?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)**from 10:30-11:30.**
**On Thursday, I’ll be joining the**[**Hanover Dems for a night of “Drinking Liberally”**](https://us.list-manage.com/F_M9m6j5oyq?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)**—featuring great drinks, food, and conversations at Mexico Restaurant in Mechanicsville from 6:30pm-8:30pm.**
**On Friday, we are throwing a an**[**Election Weekend Kickoff Party**](https://us.list-manage.com/6AfbTnPG_cl?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)**from 6-8pm at McCormick’s Big Whisky Grill in Henrico. Tickets start at $30, but volunteers get in for free!**
**On Saturday, we’ll be at the**[**Mathews Democrats Annual Crab Steam**](https://us.list-manage.com/c3mqavMmrcZ?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)**. This will take place from 5p-7pm on Saturday, August 1st, at Piankatank Ruritan Club. This is a great opportunity to share in a special summer tradition during the final few days of the campaign.**
**Finally, I am hosting a**[**watch party on Election Night at my house**](https://us.list-manage.com/CjUIpFMUB0F?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)**, and I am personally inviting you to join me as we celebrate the incredible work this campaign has done over the past nine months. You can RSVP for that—and all remaining campaign events—by clicking below:**
* [Tuesday Phone Bank (Online)—Tuesday, July 28th, 5:30pm-6:30pm](https://us.list-manage.com/km7KADAuXHQ?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)
* [Wittman Wednesday Protest, Yorktown—Wednesday, July 29th, 10:30am-11:30am](https://us.list-manage.com/GWsP6TtJ15Z?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)
* [Thursday Phone Bank (Online)—Thursday, July 30th, 6:45pm-8:00pm](https://us.list-manage.com/nKKYJXMPTMB?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)
* [Drinking Liberally with Hanover Dems—Thursday, July 30th, 6:30pm-8:30pm](https://us.list-manage.com/qBaucWDdTS7?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)
* [Election Weekend Kickoff Party—Friday, July 31st, 6:00pm-8:00pm](https://us.list-manage.com/Ff2yYHwd8Gy?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)
* [Mathews Dems Annual Crab Steam—Saturday, August 1st, 5:00pm-7:00pm](https://us.list-manage.com/18kyLUpzDDm?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)
* [Sunday Phone Bank (Online)—Sunday, August 2nd, 2:00pm-4:00pm](https://us.list-manage.com/xCnFWKzFq18?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)
* [Election Night Watch Party—Tuesday, August 4th, 6:30pm-10:00pm](https://us.list-manage.com/agz8rYepsN9?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)

**Every door you knocked, every phone call you made, every dollar you donated, and every text you sent out helped us get to this point. I can’t thank you enough. Now let’s finish the job together.**
**—Elizabeth Dempsey Beggs**

# Just The Truth
Your No-BS Newsletter Dear Readers, Today's sponsor, BRAVE for Good, is helping Kirk Cameron expand “See You at the Library Day” by providing wholesome, faith-filled Story Hour Kits designed to bring patriotic and traditional values back into public libraries across America. The Just The Truth Team

| | Fellow Conservative, If you haven’t heard about “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, _**[please let me tell you why it’s so critical.](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001._iltqNytX8R9_iqLaPZU6_It_HwwR2kK3CjKeiy9qBNPzTo2nEx_EChD6yU5S2ke9SLHMYMIpCs7RuO-BMui5YUeP3OipcS3QrkK8awZyRb5H4bicZhdBHqO1SnDKBLueJEhx-dyo3q4zgUI7GT0BmH80UyprZ9ONEXdjcSBA_u0q5bmFS5nz2hr3yzVGu4gzvt2tVimxn_0YlcCg2TYi2VOhDANKyWTEx6cnhxcTwVr6nlbdMKSgFxpkVjZhO8JqjzQ5ZAjzqXILKEZHd3TL9hkqLKK2jZ9npyAvFW9jNIgV24djInMHfVLIoDgtR3lkpntJUVs5MrBg6iI-1vT-A/4sp/c7qFvp_5RB2NhPGH7F0dZQ/h1/h001.w5AC_L2qyVUWYk-luokvXLuop4lcGYG-Jd4b_HwaNf4)**_ Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian.She would fill your mind with classics like _Pat the Bunny_ and _The Little Engine That Could_. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the _Three Musketeers_ , _Treasure Island_ and _Charlotte’s Web_.But today, all that has changed. | | | | | [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001tliKjArPNwO3PkT3cvBqchC8orS8olHRGkeGIhQWZJqyCTQgSCfSN6MiR8KwnZ0mtz4U5wHx7VoznwEIPxfnlEKUZZ8i17rLmtSTCXPzzKUPKm3xlyK1gZfIkjURHa1ZgRw86cvosPhidKS71wtaVKpsg3jPRs1uf8zGJH6rS4KrZFd-KJX8oDutaWAk7fjXpHNl0nzIzHE2lrpzypBvSmug_YxzBcwhvzsZMumxRjU=&c=nHTFL1apy-1zKr6YL9qRArGtj2tSTkV2ZN0Z9ZhoGBhTdwtTC1iHQA==&ch=MQugQWlzII--YnNephOgt7pKDRyKKSgPMQJvAMJYo6hLj0JgwI1wXw==)

|
Peter,
One week after early voting began on July 15, Kansas' MAGA Secretary of State Scott Schwab launched a stealth attack to invalidate mail ballots arriving within the state's 3-day post-Election Day grace period.
Schwab asked a state court to strike down the grace period and throw out any mail-in ballots that arrive after 7pm on August 4--essentially asking the courts to disenfranchise thousands of KS voters who already cast their ballots without prior notice that USPS delays could completely void their votes.
Schwab is currently running to replace Democrat Laura Kelly, who is termed out, as Governor of Kansas.
Kansas voters are also being asked in the August primary election to change the way that the state's Supreme Court justices are selected: moving from a merit-based nominating commission system to direct election at the discretion of the state's Republican majority.
The judicial ballot measure is hotly contested. It makes sense why a MAGA candidate for Governor would try to throw out as many Dem-leaning votes as possible at the last minute of voting.

Holding the line on critical issues like abortion rights, voting rights, and workplace dignity, the right to join a union, and fair wages means paying attention to elections like this one in Kansas that MAGA goes all-in to win.
Right now, Kansas Democrats are fighting alone to stop this underhanded attempt to stack their state courts with Trump cronies and MAGA loyalists who will put the Republican Party above all else.
Defend Our Courts is raising awareness of MAGA's subversion in Kansas and in swing states across the country. We are fighting to build and maintain a firewall of state courts that Trump won't be able to breach. And we are investing in the races that will determine control of the US Senate in November.

Michigan needs you,
Peter.

You've been making calls, sending texts, and supporting this campaign from
afar. Now, we're inviting you to take the next step.

As we head into the final stretch of this campaign, we're bringing
volunteers from across the country to Michigan to knock doors, talk to
voters, and help deliver the conversations that will decide this election.

If you've been looking for a way to make the biggest possible impact, this
is it.

Supporters across Michigan are opening their homes to host traveling
volunteers, making it easier than ever to spend a weekend—or longer—on the
ground with our team.

Whether you can join us for a few days or a full week, every shift you
knock helps us reach more voters and build the grassroots movement that
will carry us to victory.

name: Sen. Raphael Warnock
subject: Will you support my friend, James Talarico?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warnock for Georgia
body:
I’m counting on your help to flip Texas blue and take back the Senate.
| | |
---
Friend, I believe we can flip Texas blue this November, and that’s because I believe James Talarico has what it takes to win.

We’ll be honest, the last few weeks have been insane. We emailed you about the Supreme Court decision in _NRSC v. FEC_ , which gave billionaires the green light to funnel _even more money_ to candidates through parties to stop us from flipping the House and Senate this year. We reached out after Donald Trump’s 30-minute speech full of 2020 election conspiracy theories to make sure you know how the DNC is combating his attacks on our elections. And we’ve explained that Trump and Republicans have **_nearly a billion dollars_** in their pocket and how we need your support, because 99.7% of the DNC’s donations come from grassroots donors. We weren’t quite sure how Democrats would respond to messages like these. **But Derek, after we reached out,_something powerful happened..._** First, Susan from Pennsylvania gave $25. Then Joyce from Colorado pitched in $20. And Alejandro from New York contributed $3. And when thousands more like them donated, we had a whole movement of people across the country committed to fighting back against the Trump administration and making sure we’re able to elect Democrats nationwide this year. **Now, we need you to join them by making your first donation of the year before our end-of-month deadline.** When you donate to the DNC, you’re helping us send a powerful message to Donald Trump and his MAGA allies that the grassroots momentum lies with Democrats, and that **we’re not giving up.** [**Your $7 donation, along with the thousands of others from Democrats in every corner of the country, helps us power our efforts to organize, register voters, and distribute necessary resources across the country. Together, we’ll fight to elect Democrats up and down the ballot, flip the House and the Senate, and put a massive check on Trump’s agenda this November. Corporate donors are spending _tens of millions of dollars_ trying to stop our candidates from winning in Michigan because there's no question about who these candidates are or what they believe in:
* **Abdul** left medicine for public service after realizing too many people were getting sick because they couldn't afford the basics — and he went on to help cancel hundreds of millions of dollars in medical debt.
* **Donavan** has spent his career organizing alongside workers and fighting for Detroit families who work hard but still struggle to afford groceries, pay the rent, or keep up with rising costs.
* **Will** has spent years fighting to keep families in their homes and make Mid-Michigan a place where everyone can afford to live — with good union jobs, safe housing, and communities that can thrive for generations.

Corporate donors are spending millions because they’re scared. They’ve seen working class-champions like **Brad Lander** in New York, **Melat Kiros** in Colorado, **Randy Villegas** in California, and **Chris Rabb** in Pennsylvania triumph over the corporate wing of the Democratic Party, and they see their power and influence on the decline. They know these candidates can't be bought. And they fear that wins in Michigan will add more fuel to the fire that has ignited a movement for working class representation. **If Abdul, Donavan, and Will win on August 4th, it won’t just be another victory for progressives over the corporate Democrats, it will signal a seismic shift in our national politics and prove that voters are tired of the corporate elite controlling our politics.** That’s why the interests that benefit from that status quo aren't taking any chances. AIPAC, crypto billionaires, and wealthy AI interests are pouring unprecedented amounts of money into Michigan to keep the establishment in power. **And the numbers are staggering, Peter.**
* AIPAC has spent nearly **$30 million** trying to defeat Abdul — the most it's ever spent in a single race.1
* A crypto Super PAC has poured more than **$1 million** into attacks against Donavan because they see his opponent as another opportunity to advance the crypto industry's agenda in Washington.2
* And wealthy interests backing the rapid expansion of AI data centers are spending heavily against Will because they know he'll stand in the way of corporations that want to profit from an unchecked AI buildout while working families and local communities bear the costs.3

None of this is happening by accident. **The billionaire class is throwing everything they’ve got to defeat our candidates in Michigan because for them, this fight is existential.** And while we'll never match the billionaire money flooding these races, our movement has always been built differently. We organize. We knock on doors. We make calls. We have conversations with our neighbors. We show up for each other. And when it's time to fight, millions of ordinary people pitch in what they can because they believe a better future is worth building together. That's how we've already helped elect 16 _Working Families Party champions_ in competitive congressional primaries this cycle. **And that's how we'll help Abdul, Donavan, and Will win, too.** [**This is a defining moment for our movement, Peter. If Abdul El-Sayed , Donavan McKinney , **andWill Lawrence win next week, we'll send three Working Families Party champions one step closer to Congress, build on our string of congressional victories this year, and prove that our movement isn't slowing down. We'll remind ourselves, and everyone watching, that when working people organize together, we can overcome even the deepest pockets. And we'll carry that momentum into every fight that's still to come. Every contribution helps us compete with the flood of super PAC money pouring into these races. Thanks for being part of this movement, — WFP's Digital Team \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Maurice Mitchell, Working Families Party Date: July 24, 2026 Subject: This is a defining moment for our movement Hi Peter, Maurice Mitchell here, National Director of the Working Families Party. Every election cycle, there are a handful of races that become bigger than themselves. They become a test of whether our movement can keep building the kind of political power working people need to change this country. This year, three of those races are in Michigan. Then, if you have a few more minutes, I'd like to tell you why these races have become a proving ground for our movement — and why some of the wealthiest interests in the country are spending millions to stop our candidates. In less than two weeks, Michigan voters will decide whether three WFP champions — Abdul El-Sayed , Donavan McKinney , and Will Lawrence — move one step closer to Congress. Corporate donors are spending tens of millions of dollars trying to stop our candidates from winning in Michigan because there's no question about who these candidates are or what they believe in: Abdul left medicine for public service after realizing too many people were getting sick because they couldn't afford the basics — and he went on to help cancel hundreds of millions of dollars in medical debt. Donavan has spent his career organizing alongside workers and fighting for Detroit families who work hard but still struggle to afford groceries, pay the rent, or keep up with rising costs. Will has spent years fighting to keep families in their homes and make Mid-Michigan a place where everyone can afford to live — with good union jobs, safe housing, and communities that can thrive for generations. Corporate donors are spending millions because they’re scared. They’ve seen working class-champions like Brad Lander in New York, Melat Kiros in Colorado, Randy Villegas in California, and Chris Rabb in Pennsylvania triumph over the corporate wing of the Democratic Party, and they see their power and influence on the decline. They know these candidates can't be bought. And they fear that wins in Michigan will add more fuel to the fire that has ignited a movement for working class representation. If Abdul, Donavan, and Will win on August 4th, it won’t just be another victory for progressives over the corporate Democrats, it will signal a seismic shift in our national politics and prove that voters are tired of the corporate elite controlling our politics. That’s why the interests that benefit from that status quo aren't taking any chances. AIPAC, crypto billionaires, and wealthy AI interests are pouring unprecedented amounts of money into Michigan to keep the establishment in power. And the numbers are staggering, Peter. AIPAC has spent nearly $30 million trying to defeat Abdul — the most it's ever spent in a single race.1 A crypto Super PAC has poured more than $1 million into attacks against Donavan because they see his opponent as another opportunity to advance the crypto industry's agenda in Washington.2 And wealthy interests backing the rapid expansion of AI data centers are spending heavily against Will because they know he'll stand in the way of corporations that want to profit from an unchecked AI buildout while working families and local communities bear the costs.3 None of this is happening by accident. The billionaire class is throwing everything they’ve got to defeat our candidates in Michigan because for them, this fight is existential. And while we'll never match the billionaire money flooding these races, our movement has always been built differently. We organize. We knock on doors. We make calls. We have conversations with our neighbors. We show up for each other. And when it's time to fight, millions of ordinary people pitch in what they can because they believe a better future is worth building together. That's how we've already helped elect 16 Working Families Party champions in competitive congressional primaries this cycle. And that's how we'll help Abdul, Donavan, and Will win, too. clean_body: | | | | | Peter, it’s John James. I wanted to introduce myself. Before I say anything else—as someone who has logged 750 combat hours in Iraq—I know every second counts, and there’s not a moment in the day we should be wasting. I promise I will not waste your time. I just want to tell you a little about myself; it’s about time we got well-acquainted. I was born and raised in Michigan, and throughout high school, I felt a deep-rooted call to service. I decided I wouldn’t just read about service in the magazines, I would live it. Graduating from West Point was just the beginning of my eight years in the United States Army. During Operation Iraqi Freedom, I led Apache Helicopter Platoons, and I feel like I spent more time in the air than I did on the ground. Some nights, I didn’t know if I’d make it through the next day, and every mission I flew, I went into the unknown. Throughout my service, I had the honor of receiving a Combat Action Badge and two Air Medals. I wouldn’t trade my time in the service for anything, but I’ll be honest, it was good coming home, and I can rest easy knowing I did my country proud. After coming back stateside, I swapped my fatigues for a suit. I took over the family business, creating jobs here in Michigan and earning a master’s in supply chain management from Penn State and an MBA from the University of Michigan. I was never one to rest, and after making so many life-or-death decisions in Iraq, I knew every second mattered; I wanted to make the most of my time for my family and me. I never for a second considered running for office, and the last thing I’d consider myself is a politician... I saw the Democrats destroying our country, and I knew my service to this great nation wasn’t over yet. Everybody told me running for office isn’t easy, but my heart was telling me it was the right thing to do. I won my election, with the help of President Trump, and started delivering results for my new constituents. Then, in 2023, when the Establishment tried to move on from Trump and being MAGA was seen as risky or politically inconvenient, I was among the first in Michigan to endorse President Trump for 2024. Loyalty isn’t a talking point to me; it’s the only way I know how to operate. My dedication to this country, my loyalty towards my constituents, and my desire to see the greatest nation on earth excel are part of the reasons why I’m now emailing you, but they’re not my #1 reason why... These three kids are the reason why I’m sending this message to you, as a Republican and father running to be the next governor of Michigan Having my own family taught me more lessons than I could list, and it was the one thing being in the U.S. Army didn’t prepare me for. But it also awoke in me a desire to do EVERYTHING and ANYTHING I can to ensure my kids have bright futures. My family means everything to me, and Michigan is our home; that’s why I will fight like my life depends on it to save this state and win this November. I’m under no illusions; I know this election will be one of the toughest challenges I’ve faced in my entire life, but after everything I’ve done in my service, it’s nothing I can’t handle. Unfortunately, the one thing I can’t directly control is spending, and the Democrats will do everything in their power to stop my campaign from making it to the ballot box this November. Nothing can stop us from saving this country if we stand together. Today, I’m asking you to make a small-dollar gift of $10, $25, $50 or ANYTHING you can spare to fuel my campaign’s fight as we approach our upcoming primary election. Thank you for taking the time to read my message. I hope to hear from you in the days to come. ---
| | Fellow Conservative, If you haven’t heard about “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, _**[please let me tell you why it’s so critical.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=3099b1cfd2c74e61bc04029cddda1fc0&_e=KbhoijmC7dDBmgOHQvNhOVIuz0Ah3qcqNFpXVS5HfcsVVKDxSgFATSAwpMpwH60UA89feWflkTRxR-4Kjol_0l7WdpB3kYlNVBSu2E16GYSLmZfTtHej62i5KdI-NbJRawmnYRhc-fg62w__k6-RAfQ4iIIEh1-Mt577uQhNij9bRMiVotqJc2dtF_Bgsf9wBxEQ8VfSIEexYCjgsFCDtR6LXPfhmP14XmFStqKYfpJeslj7vC7w5Y2_Hx3pwxU7W8ihQL0Sz01myB699u9tabu8ddmm7xNp5j2AwTjy3tYdrGQnp0UbGXS47IBg_2wbdhslt_FIcp3NIRCNo9oiGYZAHvxqWlJJ6AuDwqbGown-yYYVQARUeIxdmYf4TSJsSVUuXZEP-jBvjKA27b6XyKhAWiyDhAmcFbH6KdkwoeV66_nJjJsAEgH2-WsL69506LVzGKGPyVisLvXHgnbDRunpKIV8CCNbSuue0cNBjThAgOSugPHKMe26S8TY__tEKuaHkHczf2zgT5Y9etbNVHvet6bViQ8HnUceg1pZ6IUXiAU-b3t4fLIJJvXVz1GzxksUrs21lrbQqDkqm2SUB8gsGXlnU6zARHpRysA6eCqJOhYL7VDL01z30qmY4rrIsrRTEwqnQTrgH5fqcaZF5CViqlaJIhkJ6YhX_bMzE7IkB4yzF9nntPXESF8idUJzLNzLTHrsnnjZuf8sWs5QFyMtxKpcJlIrBeoWVJYMWE8%3D)**_ Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian.She would fill your mind with classics like _Pat the Bunny_ and _The Little Engine That Could_. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the _Three Musketeers_ , _Treasure Island_ and _Charlotte’s Web_.But today, all that has changed. Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and GLBTQR+ writers and voices.’ Radical librarians call _Adventures of Huckleberry Finn_ and _To Kill a Mockingbird_ “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic’ _Little House_ series.And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... _A is for Activist._ An _ABC_ _board_ _book_ for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for.” _Woke Baby_. “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.” _Prince and Knight._ The “premier queer-friendly fairy tale” about a prince who marries a knight instead of a princess. And _The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish._ A “family-friendly celebration of drag” that encourages children to “work it.”I wish I could tell you this was only happening in places like New York City and San Francisco...

BRAVE for Good was started by BRAVE Books -- the small Christian publisher of my book “As You Grow” –- because so many patriots were asking how they could help “See You at the Library Day” with a tax-deductible gift.Your sponsorship gift helps send a ‘Story Hour Kit’ to every parent, grandparent, and patriot who’s organizing a “See You at the Library” event. The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative values back into our public libraries: instructions for booking their library space and running their Story Hour, small American flags for little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards, and other specialty items. Your sponsorship gift is the only way we can fund our “Story Hours” for 250,000 children to counter the radical leftists who’ve taken control of our libraries.We don’t have the millions behind us like the giant taxpayer-funded ALA. Singlehandedly, you’ll be reaching 50 children with our wholesome, Godly, and patriotic message. Whatever you can give whether it’s $35, $125, or anything higher or lower please send in your sponsorship gift in the next 48 hours so we know how many libraries we have sponsored for this year’s “See You at the Library Day.” Thank you! Friends,
Over the weekend, we launched 16 canvasses in all four counties in NY-17. Nearly 250 incredible volunteers knocked on more than 4,500 doors across the district — talking to voters about our plans to root out corruption in Washington and create a better, more affordable future for the Hudson Valley. To every one of you who chooses action over indifference and continues to show up week after week for this campaign, especially now with just 98 days until Election Day — _thank you_. We couldn’t do this without you.

Door after door, what we heard from voters is that they are fed up. Fed up with corruption. Fed up with politicians who bend the knee to party bosses and corporate interests, while supporting policies that raise costs, threaten healthcare, and make it harder to afford basic necessities. **No one embodies Washington’s corruption and partisanship more than Mike Lawler.** At a time when Hudson Valley families are struggling to make ends meet, Mike Lawler voted to cut healthcare and food assistance to pay for tax breaks for billionaires, accepted over $1 million in corporate PAC money, took tens of thousands from monopoly utility companies while Hudson Valley energy bills have climbed more than 50%, and now has voted five times to prolong the war with Iran — carelessly risking American lives while working families at home pay the price. Mike Lawler has never failed to put his allegiance to his party above the needs of his constituents, voting with Donald Trump 100% of the time. We cannot afford another two years of someone who cares more about doing what's politically expedient than doing what’s right. I used to tell my soldiers that doing the right thing when it’s easy, when it comes with no personal cost, that’s just doing your job. But doing the right thing when it comes with real sacrifice, to your career or even your life, _that_ is courage. That’s the spirit of this campaign. Democrats, Republicans, and Independents united by the simple belief that this moment demands leaders who put country over party and have the courage to do what’s right.
With gratitude and fire, **Cait Conley**

clean_body: | | | | Friends, Over the weekend, we launched 16 canvasses in all four counties in NY-17. Nearly 250 incredible volunteers knocked on more than 4,500 doors across the district — talking to voters about our plans to root out corruption in Washington and create a better, more affordable future for the Hudson Valley. To every one of you who chooses action over indifference and continues to show up week after week for this campaign, especially now with just 98 days until Election Day — thank you. We couldn’t do this without you. Door after door, what we heard from voters is that they are fed up. Fed up with corruption. Fed up with politicians who bend the knee to party bosses and corporate interests, while supporting policies that raise costs, threaten healthcare, and make it harder to afford basic necessities. No one embodies Washington’s corruption and partisanship more than Mike Lawler. At a time when Hudson Valley families are struggling to make ends meet, Mike Lawler voted to cut healthcare and food assistance to pay for tax breaks for billionaires, accepted over $1 million in corporate PAC money, took tens of thousands from monopoly utility companies while Hudson Valley energy bills have climbed more than 50%, and now has voted five times to prolong the war with Iran — carelessly risking American lives while working families at home pay the price. Mike Lawler has never failed to put his allegiance to his party above the needs of his constituents, voting with Donald Trump 100% of the time. We cannot afford another two years of someone who cares more about doing what's politically expedient than doing what’s right. I used to tell my soldiers that doing the right thing when it’s easy, when it comes with no personal cost, that’s just doing your job. But doing the right thing when it comes with real sacrifice, to your career or even your life, that is courage. That’s the spirit of this campaign. Democrats, Republicans, and Independents united by the simple belief that this moment demands leaders who put country over party and have the courage to do what’s right. # JoAnna is officially the Democratic nominee for
# AZ-06!
---
| | July 21st was primary day in Arizona, and tens of thousands of Southern Arizonans cast their vote for Jo to officially be the candidate who is going to face off against Juan Ciscomani in November.
_“...Now more than ever, our families deserve servant leadership in Congress, and I’m honored to be the nominee our district is counting on to address the issues that matter most. We can, we must, and we WILL win. Onward to victory!”_ Jo said.
Read the full statement [here](https://us.list-manage.com/fQ6Q3eFkLNJ?e=fea3203902&c2id=b00e5bb4cdbce8e5db7719846a7b67e1).
---
[|

|

# Momentum is on our side
---
| | When we launched this campaign, we set out to prove that Southern Arizona was ready for a new generation of leadership. Thanks to you, we're doing exactly that. Together, we've:
* Outraised Juan Ciscomani for three quarters.
* Led in every poll.
* Won the Democratic nomination with over 78,000 votes - nearly 2,000 more votes than Ciscomani.

The results speak for themselves: our momentum is growing. Our campaign continues to show up across Southern Arizona. And as Juan Ciscomani’s out of touch attacks ramp up, our communities are ready for leadership focused on lowering costs, protecting healthcare, and serving this district. Jo’s broad coalition has earned the confidence of so many across Southern Arizona and shown that this race is one of the best opportunities to flip the House.
Now it's time to turn that momentum into victory. [Join the fight](https://us.list-manage.com/VVnp0ojI0im?e=fea3203902&c2id=b00e5bb4cdbce8e5db7719846a7b67e1)!
---
|
---
| |
# New TV Ad Just Dropped
---
| | Today, the campaign released a new ad highlighting JoAnna’s deep Arizona roots. The ad, “Daughter,” will air in English and [Spanish](https://us.list-manage.com/aBi9yEFYTFK?e=fea3203902&c2id=b00e5bb4cdbce8e5db7719846a7b67e1) across broadcast, cable, and streaming across Arizona’s Sixth Congressional District.
The ad tells JoAnna’s story: she grew up working alongside her parents in the cotton fields of Eloy, then went on to join the military and serve her country for over two decades. Now, she’s running for Congress to continue her oath of service and deliver a better future for Arizonans.
[**WATCH HERE**](https://us.list-manage.com/zg8wgZ7KZOF?e=fea3203902&c2id=b00e5bb4cdbce8e5db7719846a7b67e1)

| |
# Less than 100 days until we flip
# AZ-06!
---
| | Over the weekend, JoAnna joined Governor Katie Hobbs, Senator Mark Kelly, former Congresswoman Gabby Giffords, Congresswoman Adelita Grijalva, and Tucson Mayor Regina Romero for a rally in Tucson to mark 100 days until the November election.
Jo joined hundreds of fired-up Arizonans who are ready to get to work to flip and defend races up and down the ballot. Let’s get to it, folks!

clean_body: I want to tell you what this means to me personally. | Peter, I have to be honest with you - when President Trump called me "exceptional" and gave this campaign his complete and total endorsement, I did not take it lightly for a single second. President Trump does not hand out endorsements everyday. He gave me his because he knows I have a proven record of delivering on his agenda. I was honored to serve as his U.S. Attorney in Montana - twice. When President Trump needed someone he could trust to go after cartels, drug traffickers, and violent criminals threatening Montana families, he called on me. I delivered then and will deliver for Montana in the United States Senate. I refuse to let President Trump down. STAND WITH PRESIDENT TRUMP: The truth is, Peter, while a presidential endorsement opens doors– it does not pay for ads, staff, or the grassroots operation it takes to win a Senate race. That part is up to us. Chuck Schumer has made Montana a top target. He raised $140 million through ActBlue in a single month and is spending every dollar to flip this seat and take back the Senate. President Trump's endorsement is our greatest asset - but only if we have the resources to fight back. So my ask is simple: President Trump called me exceptional. Help me prove him right. Onward, Kurt Alme, Trump-endorsed Candidate for Senate FOLLOW KURT ALME ON SOCIAL MEDIA | | Paid for by Alme for Senate Don't want to receive any more of our emails? We hate to see you go: _.

Right now, I’m stepping in for a moment because Gina and her team are on the phones right now, pushing hard to hit our $100,000 fundraising goal.

She’s not running to climb the political ladder, Peter, she's running because she believes Texas should work for the people who live here — not the billionaires and special interests who have bought their way into Texas through the way of Greg Abbott’s office.
I’ve watched Gina spend years showing up for Texans, defending public schools, standing up for working families, and taking on corruption in Austin. That is who she is. And I know there is no better person to replace Greg Abbott after this fall.

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kh_em?refcode=emailheader&refcode2=1011ea12-ca8a-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kh_em?refcode=emailheader&refcode2=1011ea12-ca8a-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce] Friend, It's been a few weeks now since the anniversary of the July 4th floods that tore through the Texas Hill Country. I spent that morning with families in Kerrville and Hunt who are still healing from the loss of lives. Then last week, this region in our district got flooded again—leading to the further loss of homes and businesses. What I keep coming back to is this: it doesn’t have to be this way. Floods are the most common and costly natural disasters in the U.S. In 1968, Congress created the National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP) to address the increasing costs of taxpayer-funded disaster relief for flood victims and the increasing amount of damage caused by floods. More floods—and more intense floods driven by climate change—mean that more families and businesses need flood insurance now than ever before. But too many families can’t access or afford flood insurance to protect themselves from total and devastating losses. And our flood maps are not based on the most up-to-date science to protect them. Congress needs leaders who will actually update our policies to reflect the reality we're living in: more intense storms, hotter droughts, and infrastructure that has to catch up now, not after the next disaster. That's exactly the fight I'm taking to Washington, and it's a fight this campaign can't win without you. Can you chip in $25 today to help elect leaders who trust science before more communities get hurt? Hi team,
Last week I toured the Susquehanna Service Dogs facility in Lebanon County.
We heard stories of how this organization and the dogs they train have transformed people's lives. Especially veterans.
One veteran had such bad PTSD she couldn't get on an elevator. Getting a service dog changed her life, and things like a trip to the VA are easier now that she can use the elevator.
So it doesn't make sense to me that **the federal grant this group received last year has gone away.** Why wouldn't we keep funding things like this that help our veterans?
Washington always seems to find money for handouts to billionaires and favors for special interests. But when a local organization is doing important work and supporting the people who served this country, suddenly the funding disappears.
**I 'm running because it's time Congress gets its priorities straight.** I'll make sure our government keeps its promises to our veterans and invests in vital programs like this one.
**[If you 're with me, chip in today to help me flip this seat.](https://substack.com/redirect/4d9a05e6-3893-4007-bf5f-dc3e1e69a725?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
My priority will always be you.
- Rachel Wallace

China isn't fighting the US with missiles.

It's waging financial war. The weapon is gold.

Since 2000, China's domestic mines have produced approximately 8,146 tonnes of gold.

Fort Knox holds 8,133.

China surpassed America's entire official gold reserve through mining alone — before a single tonne of imports, before any central bank purchase they're willing to disclose, before the gold held by 1.4 billion citizens.

Then they passed a law: no gold leaves China. Not one ounce.
