Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. subject: They have more money than us
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?]
We need to give you a straight picture of what we're up against, because we’d rather you hear it from us than from a headline.
Republican outside groups have already spent or reserved $6.5 million in advertising in this district. All aimed at attacking Marie.
There’s a simple reason for this: They know that ours is one of the few seats in the country that actually decides who runs the House, and they've done the math.
Here's the wider picture.
The main House Republican super PAC — the one run by Speaker Johnson — booked $153 million in fall advertising back in April. It was the largest ad-buy reservation in the group's history, and we know more is coming.
Politico just reported that the main GOP committees and their allied super PACs are sitting on nearly twice as much cash as our side — and once you add in Donald Trump's super PAC, the Republican money advantage is more than three times what Democrats have.
And a recent Supreme Court ruling took the limits off how much national party committees can spend in direct coordination with their candidates. In practice, that means the money at the top can now be pointed straight into races like this one.
Now here's the part that should really scare you.
Trump is sitting on a $400 million war chest he hasn't even opened yet. His own team says the spending starts "very soon." Democrats across the country are bracing for the final five weeks of this race, when that money — and the outside groups like it — are expected to come in, as one strategist put it, "with a vengeance."
And we need you to understand how the timing works. Television time is bought months in advance. They reserved theirs in April. When those ads start running against Marie this fall, the money to answer them has to already be in the bank — you cannot raise it after the attacks start. Whatever we have by then is what we have.
We’re not telling you this to make you feel hopeless. We’re telling you because it changes where your contribution actually matters, and because we need your help now, not in October.
Money given to a national committee gets spread across a very wide map. Money given here stays here — in one of the handful of districts where the majority is genuinely won or lost. There is almost nowhere your $5 does more work.
And we are not starting from nothing. Last quarter more than 10,000 people chipped in, 91% of them giving $100 or less, and together we out-raised our opponent better than two to one. Corporate PACs have never funded this campaign and they never will. That's the whole point of it.
They have more money than us. They have always had more money than us. We've won here twice anyway, because a district full of people giving what they can turns out to be harder to beat than a super PAC. But that only works if enough people actually do it — and only if they do it early. We don't have a super PAC coming to rescue this campaign. We only have you.
We need your help today. Will you chip in $5 to help us hold one of the seats that decides the House? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?]
Thanks for your support,
Marie for Congress HQ

You can learn a lot about a politician by who can't stand them. So let me tell you who can't stand me:

**Trump's MAGA Republicans can't stand me.** I've spent years calling out their agenda for exactly what it is — a corrupt scheme that takes from working people and hands it to billionaires. They know I won't stop.

| | As the son of a union power line worker, I learned early in life the value of a dollar and the importance of hard work. Some of our hardest workers struggle each day to feed their families and afford the basics. This is a direct result of corporations siphoning their investments away from their workers and redirecting them to their shareholders, all the while raising prices on the backs of hardworking Americans. **I am proud to stand with working Washingtonians, both in my district and across our state, and I am honored to win the support of many unions in our grassroots campaign to restore the economic dignity of the working class, including:**
* Washington State Labor Council, AFL-CIO
* AFSCME Council 28 (Washington Federation of State Employees)
* Association of Flight Attendants-CWA, AFL-CIO (AFA)
* Washington State Building & Construction Trades Council

name: Sarah McBride
subject: 10 years ago today
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
10 years ago today, I had the honor of being the first transgender speaker at a major party’s convention.
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=3610%2E21716%2EByfhLc)
**10 years ago today, I had the honor of being the first transgender speaker at a major party’s convention.**
At the 2016 Democratic National Convention, I told the audience that, when I first came out, I worried that my dreams and my identity were mutually exclusive—but that I had seen so much change happen since then.
And since that convention, we’ve seen even more change happen. In 2020, I became the first openly transgender person elected as a state senator, and in 2024 I was elected as the first openly transgender person in the United States Congress.
Growing up, I never imagined that I would have the opportunity to serve my state and my country as my authentic self. And while we’ve come a long way since I was a kid, I know that this is still a frightening time for so many in our country.
The Trump administration, and MAGA Republicans in states across the country, are demonizing transgender people and rolling back our rights as a way to consolidate their political power.
**But despite their cruel attacks, we must remain firm in our values and our vision in this moment.** And just as importantly, we can never give up on our ability to win over more people to more fully see our humanity. That’s how we grow our tent of allies, defeat the hateful attacks, and lay the foundation for freedom and safety for trans people in every corner of our country and every part of our globe.
For my part, as the first trans member of Congress to be elected, the way I can guarantee I’m not the last is to quite simply be the best member of Congress that I can be. To continue to fight for what’s right and for who needs it most. And to show that trans people are multi-dimensional human beings.
That’s exactly what I plan to do — and I’m going to need your help every step of the way.
**Because in addition to being the 10 year anniversary of my speech to the Democratic National Convention, today is also important for another reason. We’re coming up on a critical end-of-month fundraising deadline on Friday night, and I’m counting on your support to help us reach our $33,000 goal.**
[**So if you can, will you pitch in $5 to my campaign before Friday’s deadline and help me keep fighting for what’s right in Congress?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260728-1.yz-fCJ&refcode=em20260728-3610&amount=5&t=2&akid=3610%2E21716%2EByfhLc)

In solidarity,
Sarah McBride

# [Social media likes don't vote. People do. ](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=208259305&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjA4MjU5MzA1LCJpYXQiOjE3ODUyNzYyMTAsImV4cCI6MTc4Nzg2ODIxMCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.UnjHALqy2O8PPSPURmPULBIPXONau2JZ_-Oj8mmiNBY)
### Have you made a plan to vote, Michigan?
| | [Haley Stevens](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---
| Jul 28
---
| [](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---

---
| | | [](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/social-media-likes-dont-vote-people?utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=email-restack-comment&action=restack-comment&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjA4MjU5MzA1LCJpYXQiOjE3ODUyNzYyMTAsImV4cCI6MTc4Nzg2ODIxMCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.UnjHALqy2O8PPSPURmPULBIPXONau2JZ_-Oj8mmiNBY&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/social-media-likes-dont-vote-people?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

Friends, I have an important question for Michiganders: **Have you voted yet?**
Absentee ballots are already sitting on coffee tables all across Michigan, and early voting is around the corner. The primary is **one week away**.
So if you are in Michigan and haven't voted, or haven't made your plan yet, will you take two minutes and do it right now? This site makes it super easy:
[I WILL VOTE](https://substack.com/redirect/77d428c2-0976-4bf3-bce0-e39eb996a291?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Let me tell you why I'm asking directly.
The polls show I'm leading in the primary AND that I'm the Democrat with the best shot of defeating MAGA Republican Mike Rogers in November.
I know we can win this race, keep Michigan blue, and flip the Senate.
But none of it matters if people don't vote.
Look, friends, I'm not in this race for attention or to get rich. I'm not here for the TV cameras or the Instagram likes. I don't have a talent agent. I'm not in this for a book deal or a podcast. And unlike my opponents, I'm not a millionaire.
I'm in this for the folks I've met in union halls. For the workers I've talked to on shop floors. For the small-business owners, retirees, nurses, and parents in every corner of this state. I've been listening, learning, and working on how to solve real problems for real people.
Is that as flashy as hanging out with a celebrity podcaster? _Nope._
Does it rack up views? _It does not._
Does it go viral? _Not unless you have a cold._
But I'm not looking for fame. I'm a public servant and I'm looking out for Michigan.
My primary opponent, Abdul El-Sayed, is incredibly skilled at getting attention online. Good for him. I'm skilled at getting sh*t done.
I helped save 200,000 jobs working for President Obama during the auto industry rescue. I helped write and pass the CHIPS and Science Act. And I fight for Michigan's working families every day in Congress.
A very online crowd has spent a ton of time making fun of my voice, my clothes, my whatever. It feels like middle school. But I want them, and everyone, to know: I don't care.
Seriously, knock yourselves out, folks. I know I'm not some overly polished influencer-celebrity-politician. Tease me all you want. I've got a job to do.
I'm a workhorse.
**I 'm going to keep showing up in real life for Michiganders, hearing their concerns, telling them my plans, and encouraging them to do the ONE thing that actually makes a difference for real people: **_**Vote.**_
So if you're in Michigan and you've already sent in your ballot, thank you. I'm grateful. You did something real, something meaningful, for our state and our country.
Now, will you text a friend and make sure they have a plan, too? If you haven't, here's that link one more time.
[MAKE YOUR PLAN TO VOTE ->](https://substack.com/redirect/77d428c2-0976-4bf3-bce0-e39eb996a291?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/2b67777f-4e82-4e6b-9275-db8d700eddfb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Let's keep working. Let's keep fighting. Let's stick it to'em.
More soon.
With grit,

Haley

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/2b67777f-4e82-4e6b-9275-db8d700eddfb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

Peter— I want to tell you about two inspiring women running for office in Arizona and Nevada whose names you probably haven't heard yet: Brenda Zamora and Clara Pratte. When election season heats up, the spotlight is on the biggest races at the top of the ballot. But some of the most important offices in America rarely make the evening news. Races like school boards, utility commissions, and state legislatures. These local and statewide positions shape our schools, protect consumers, oversee critical infrastructure, and make decisions that directly impact our daily lives. At Way to Lead, we believe lasting change means competing everywhere, not just in races that get the most attention. Power is built from the ground up, and the people who hold these offices can often have as much or even more direct influence over communities than anyone in Washington. **That’s why we're proud to support Brenda Zamora for Clark County School District Trustee in Nevada.** **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136180610/636598214/474919918?refcode=AU_WTL_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260728_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNS8xLzkxMTI4IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjkxZDkwM2FlLWNmOGEtZjExMS1iMzM3LTAwMGQzYTE1NThjZSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=FWg0j8xj_E39cXrUCaSo3ib86D0hW2peaynMAcykSks=)** As a Trustee, Brenda helps oversee the education of more than 300,000 students in the nation’s 5th largest school district. As a mom of 3, Brenda knows Clark County schools and the struggles of parents intimately. With one of her daughters, she has personally navigated the process of developing an Individualized Education Plan, and fiercely advocates for those resources to be made more accessible to those who need them. Outside of the School Board, Brenda advocates for equal and fair access to elections, and she works to bring resources to families in low-income households. She is a dedicated advocate who believes that every voice counts, and that education is the key to creating a better future for all. Brenda’s commitment to those values influences policies that affect students, their families, and their teachers every day, and she is exactly the kind of leader that we are dedicated to elevating in our communities. **We are also proud to endorse Clara Pratte for the Arizona Corporation Commission.** **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136180611/636598215/474919918?refcode=AU_WTL_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260728_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNS8xLzkxMTI4IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjkxZDkwM2FlLWNmOGEtZjExMS1iMzM3LTAwMGQzYTE1NThjZSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=FWg0j8xj_E39cXrUCaSo3ib86D0hW2peaynMAcykSks=)** While many voters aren’t as familiar with this office, the Corporation Commission makes decisions that affect the cost and reliability of essential services for millions of Arizonans as they regulate utilities and oversee energy policy. Clara is running against a Turning Point USA-backed candidate who wants to invest $2 billion into coal power and opposes clean energy. If elected, she will not only help stop those devastating investments but also bring thoughtful leadership and accountability to an office with enormous influence over Arizona’s future. We need more Brendas and Claras in our politics today. This is exactly what Way to Lead was built for: finding the races that decide who has real power over people's everyday lives and backing the leaders who will use that power for working families. clean_body: | Peter— I want to tell you about two inspiring women running for office in Arizona and Nevada whose names you probably haven't heard yet: Brenda Zamora and Clara Pratte. When election season heats up, the spotlight is on the biggest races at the top of the ballot. But some of the most important offices in America rarely make the evening news. Races like school boards, utility commissions, and state legislatures. These local and statewide positions shape our schools, protect consumers, oversee critical infrastructure, and make decisions that directly impact our daily lives. At Way to Lead, we believe lasting change means competing everywhere, not just in races that get the most attention. Power is built from the ground up, and the people who hold these offices can often have as much or even more direct influence over communities than anyone in Washington. That’s why we're proud to support Brenda Zamora for Clark County School District Trustee in Nevada. = As a Trustee, Brenda helps oversee the education of more than 300,000 students in the nation’s 5th largest school district. As a mom of 3, Brenda knows Clark County schools and the struggles of parents intimately. With one of her daughters, she has personally navigated the process of developing an Individualized Education Plan, and fiercely advocates for those resources to be made more accessible to those who need them. Outside of the School Board, Brenda advocates for equal and fair access to elections, and she works to bring resources to families in low-income households. She is a dedicated advocate who believes that every voice counts, and that education is the key to creating a better future for all. Brenda’s commitment to those values influences policies that affect students, their families, and their teachers every day, and she is exactly the kind of leader that we are dedicated to elevating in our communities. We are also proud to endorse Clara Pratte for the Arizona Corporation Commission. = While many voters aren’t as familiar with this office, the Corporation Commission makes decisions that affect the cost and reliability of essential services for millions of Arizonans as they regulate utilities and oversee energy policy. Clara is running against a Turning Point USA-backed candidate who wants to invest $2 billion into coal power and opposes clean energy. If elected, she will not only help stop those devastating investments but also bring thoughtful leadership and accountability to an office with enormous influence over Arizona’s future. We need more Brendas and Claras in our politics today. This is exactly what Way to Lead was built for: finding the races that decide who has real power over people's everyday lives and backing the leaders who will use that power for working families. Pete Hegseth has fired almost as many four-star flag officers in the last year and a half as in the preceding 160 years. Seriously, we looked this up.
#
Know what’s nuts?
Pete Hegseth has fired almost as many four-star flag officers in the last year and a half as in the preceding 160 years. Seriously, we looked this up.
Based on what we could find, 11 four-stars had been fired, relieved of command, or forced out between 1866 and 2024. Since Trump took office and Hegseth became SecDef, they’ve forced out 9 four-stars. You widen that to three- and two-stars, and the number goes up to 12.
These leaders are not getting fired for poor performance, or because they’re not qualified. We’re talking about the most seasoned, experienced people our Military has to offer. Each of them was elevated by their own peers based on their resumes, their capabilities, and their qualifications.
They’re getting fired because they aren’t white, or they aren’t men. They’re getting fired because they are inconvenient — because they’ve pointed out when Hegseth or Trump have been wrong, because they’ve stood for the Constitution, and stood up for the people they led.
Hegseth won’t shut up about lethality — but he’s gutting the Military of its best leaders. And you know what he’s going to replace those leaders with? Mandatory testosterone screening.
Quack science without any grounding in research. No policy follow up and no prescriptive guidance, because there can’t be any. Doctors won’t back this, because testosterone replacement is a solution for a very specific problem. Broad based adoption is a huge risk because it comes with a slew of nasty side effects, many worse than the supposed problem Hegseth thinks he’s trying to solve.
So this is what the people we’re sending to war get. Quack science and social experiments from the least qualified SecDef to ever sit in the chair.
Peter, please. We need you to make a donation to VoteVets. We’re asking because if we don’t take back the House and Senate later this year, there is nothing we can do to stop Trump and Hegseth from doing more damage to the finest Military to walk the Earth.

The Republican Party is now trying to accomplish something unheard of in Western civilization - hold power indefinitely while accepting responsibility for absolutely nothing.
The GOP has been in control of the U.S. House for nearly four years and the Presidency and Senate for nearly two. And yet the republicans are going into the midterms blaming the ongoing economic problems on Joe Biden, not on Trump's tariffs, corruption, and wars.

_Story by Shuaib Almosawa and Jeb Boone_
SANA'A, Yemen--In January 2012, Saudi Arabia's then-defense minister, Salman bin Abdulaziz, issued a directive advising a shadowy Saudi government committee to widen Yemen's northern war. In broad terms, the plan entailed engineering a rift between northern Yemen's Shia majority and Salafi Sunnis when one previously had not existed.
The order came at a time when Yemen's internal power structures were in disarray following a 2011 popular uprising against the longtime rule of Yemeni president Ali Abdullah Saleh. Saudi Arabia, which shares a 812-mile border with Yemen, had long managed delicate relations with its southern neighbor and now looked with growing concern at the chaos unfolding within the country. By 2012, Yemen's army had splintered into rival factions both camped inside the capital city, Sana'a. Saleh had stepped down after 33 years of power and his former vice president Abd Rabo Mansur Hadi stood prepared to take the reins through a single candidate election--hardly the legitimate figure the fractured political landscape demanded.
Worst of all for Saudi Arabia, its old rival Ansarallah--which was based in Yemen's northern highlands with a stronghold in the city of Saada--stood poised to take advantage of the chaos.
Known as the Houthis, Ansarallah grew out of a revival movement among Yemen's Zaydis, followers of a branch of Shia Islam that ruled the northern highlands for a thousand years until 1962. Zaydism sits closer in doctrine to the four orthodox Sunni legal schools than to the Twelver Shiism of Iran, and in the early 2000s most Zaydis hadn't yet joined the Houthi cause.
Salman's plan was essentially twofold: to arm the Yemeni tribes fighting the Houthi movement, most of them ultra-conservative adherents of the Salafi school of Islamic jurisprudence and educated in the kingdom's own Wahhabi current; and to drive a wedge between Ansarallah and the wider Zaydi community.
A January 2012 [cable](https://substack.com/redirect/c638bcc1-6eb5-40ee-aeeb-949057e14f50?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) directed to a secretive special government committee handling Saudi Arabia's relationship to Yemen stamped "Extremely Secret, Very Urgent" with Salman's signature at the bottom outlines the plan: "The Special Committee of the Council of Ministers should discuss and study supporting Yemeni tribes hostile to the Houthis if they fail to commit to reconciliation with Ahl al-Sunnah [Salafists] in Saada, enabling multiple fronts against them, fostering discord between Houthis and Zaydi followers, while ensuring the fighting does not appear as a Sunni-Shia sectarian war in Yemen or that the Kingdom is behind it."
A January 2012 cable to the Special Committee of the Saudi Council of Ministers signed by Saudi Arabia's then-defense minister Salman bin Abdulaziz
Salman did not want it to appear sectarian because a war between Ansarallah and Saudi Arabia framed as a purely sectarian conflict, Sunni vs. Shia, would drive northern Yemen's majority Zaydi Shia population toward support for Ansarallah out of a sense of religious duty or alignment with the cause.
The kingdom's proxy fighting force in northern Yemen at the time, the Salafist Sunni tribes, were just one part of their plan. In order to isolate Ansarallah from Yemen's wider Zaydi Shia community, fighting needed to look like a local quarrel. If violence appeared to be carried out by Saudi-backed Sunnis against local Shia communities, the Houthis would quickly become the defenders of the sect rather than a local nuisance.
Salman's plan to "foster discord" between the Houthis and other Zaydis meant drawing a sectarian line in Yemen where none yet ran. Saudi Arabia would fund the fight from one side of that line and keep its name off it.
But this attempt to carefully curate the narrative would ultimately go on to fail when Saudi Arabia launched an air war backed by the U.S. against Ansarallah in 2015 that began decimating Saada soon after Salman was appointed king.
The secret cable is part of a [trove of classified Saudi cables](https://substack.com/redirect/b95bc897-2731-4df6-ad04-6651a7b25503?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) obtained by Drop Site News. The cables were issued by the Special Committee of the Saudi Council of Ministers, the agency that has run the kingdom's Yemen policy since 1962. Riyadh created the committee the year republican officers backed by Egyptian president Gamal Abdel Nasser toppled Yemen's thousand-year-old Zaydi imamate, and charged it with managing "all matters related to Yemeni affairs." The committee reports directly to the Saudi Prime Minister's Office and the Saudi ambassador in Sana'a sits as a member. Its name does not appear in any official media in either country.
For more than half a century the special committee has been the kingdom's primary instrument in Yemen. It helped organize strategy toward Yemen and kept individual files on Yemen's tribal sheikhs, religious leaders, military commanders, and politicians in government and opposition alike. It also ran allowances--monthly stipends paid out to keep powerful Yemenis loyal to Riyadh. The secret cables date from 2010 to 2012. They record payments and informant reports, the wars the committee funded, and the terms it set for the men on its books.
Single pages from the set of cables obtained by Drop Site have been previously published by Wikileaks and by local media in Yemen, corroborating the larger tranche's authenticity. Drop Site contacted several Saudi government offices to ask for comment on the cables but did not receive any response.
This is the first in a series of reports based on the [Saudi Special Committee Cables](https://substack.com/redirect/b95bc897-2731-4df6-ad04-6651a7b25503?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by Drop Site News. We are publishing the cables in both Arabic and English here.
The cables help shed light on Riyadh's machinations in Yemen at a time when Saudi Arabia and Ansarallah appear to be hurtling toward open conflict once again. An attack by Saudi Arabia on Sana'a earlier this month sparked retaliatory strikes by Ansarallah followed by a declared naval blockade on Saudi Arabia in the Bab al-Mandab strait. The latest developments threaten to completely upend a four-year-long ceasefire that could ultimately play a role in intensifying the U.S. war with Iran. The roots of the conflict between Ansarallah and Riyadh can be found in part in Saudi Arabia's attempts to foment internal strife within Yemen.
## **The Plan to Open Multiple Fronts Against Ansarallah**
The same January 2012 cable names two men tasked with carrying out Salman's plan. The cable claimed Sheikh Mohammed al-Imam, who ran a Salafi institute in the city of Dhamar, "prepared 300 armed men to target Houthi positions" to relieve pressure on the Salafis of Dammaj who were battling the Houthis, though the claim could not be independently verified. Located in the Saada governorate of northwest Yemen, Dammaj was the base of Saudi-influenced Salafi seminary built in the Zaydi heartland in 1979, and by 2012 it had become the symbolic front line of the war. The cable also said that a serving Yemeni army officer, the artillery brigade commander Hussein Khiran, smuggled the fighters their ammunition.
It is not clear from the cables that Drop Site obtained whether these specific actions were taken, but Saudi Arabia did back, arm, and fund Salafi fighters to battle Ansarallah.
The cable also said that Ansarallah leader Abdulmalik al-Houthi sent envoys to two estranged Zaydi figures, Mohammed Abdulazim and Abdullah al-Razami, to plead for fighters. "We now cannot resist the Wahhabis," Abdulmalik al-Houthi reportedly said, referring to the Salafi tribes. "If you do not support us we will hand Saada over to them, because we cannot continue." Abdulazim refused the request, while Al-Razami sent seventy men, according to the cable.
A separate cable records the money. Saudi Prince Mishal bin Abdullah, then governor of the border province of Najran, signed an Interior Ministry cable dated May 7, 2012 under the subject line "Regarding the Houthis and the Sunnis." The cable states that Mishal's office received an installment of five million Saudi Riyals (about $1.3 million) and passed the money to the Dammaj and Aahim fronts before requesting a second installment of funds. The cable also reports that the kingdom's men armed and supplied the Aahim front in the province of Hajjah and were arranging to open a third front in Rahub. It also endorses a plan by a Salafi sheikh named Musleh bin Hamad Fanis Al-Athla to build a new branch of the Dammaj institute, calling it "a good thing" that "helps weaken the Houthi movement."
Saudi Arabia had been financially backing anti-Houthi Yemeni border tribes for years. Before Salman's 2012 plan to engineer a rift in the north, a special committee cable dated [March 15, 2010](https://substack.com/redirect/f57c5ec0-691a-4bc3-95ef-c7423d1efe1b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) signed by King Abdullah authorized the immediate release of 50 million Saudi riyals (around $13 million) to arm, supply, and financially support the tribes battling Ansarallah along the border.
A March 2012 [report](https://substack.com/redirect/4d19b389-9d3e-4d02-b38d-089bc82c2820?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from the General Intelligence Presidency (GIP), a powerful Saudi intelligence agency, signed by intelligence chief Muqrin bin Abdulaziz describes former president Ali Abdullah Saleh secretly funding the Houthis as a counterweight to Salafi forces. By the report's account, he steered some 12 billion Yemeni riyals (roughly $55.8 million) their way over an undisclosed time period, because the movement "poses an obstacle to the Salafi current in Yemen." While Saleh did support the Houthis at various times, the Saudi intelligence assessment claiming billions of Yemeni riyals could not be independently verified and may have been exaggerated by informants in a bid to prompt Saudi to provide more funding to counter it.
Saudi Arabia armed one side. Saleh backed the other. The Zaydi north absorbed the war that both were funding and the damage was catastrophic. Fighting in Dammaj continued from October 2011 to January 2014 and spread to other Houthi strongholds in Saada, Hajjah, Amran and al-Jawf. Casualty numbers and damage reports appear throughout the Saudi cables, quoting Houthi commanders and often citing "large [casualty] numbers from both sides."
The Red Cross documented more than 100 dead in the first siege of Dammaj in late 2011, among them four children. [A report](https://substack.com/redirect/cb7f5e5e-d668-49a4-82fe-12f3ff1737dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from Yemen's health authorities counted 199 killed, 29 of them children, and 594 wounded in the final hundred days alone. When a ceasefire was implemented in January 2014, three hundred buses evacuated roughly 10,000 people, evacuating foreigners and those who sought to escape what was understood to be another round of inevitable fighting.
In early 2014, the Houthis overran Dammaj and expelled the Salafi students Riyadh had paid to protect. By September 2014 they had taken over the capital, Sana'a.
The covert war escalated into a full blown conflict in March 2015 when a Saudi-led coalition of Gulf nations, with American military, intelligence and logistical support, began a years-long bombing campaign of northern Yemen. While Salman wanted to ensure the fighting did not appear as a Sunni-Shia sectarian war, the kingdom did ultimately play on sectarianism to rally Salafist Sunnis to join its campaign against Ansarallah.
The bombing campaign lasted eight years across over 25,000 strikes, nearly a [third](https://substack.com/redirect/3ad991ac-4584-4d34-87cd-537547f7ac4f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of which struck civilian sites. The accompanying naval and air blockade contributed to the world's largest cholera outbreak in history, and what the UN for years called the world's worst humanitarian crisis. By the end of 2021, the UN put the war's toll at 377,000 dead, most of them from hunger and disease.
Ansarallah, the movement Salman's ministry once hoped to fracture, has remained in control of most of Yemen for the past decade. It has fired sporadic missiles at Israel in solidarity with Gaza and targeted commercial ships in the Red Sea, most recently declaring a blockade on all Saudi vessels through the Bab al-Mandab strait. The cables show how Saudi Arabia tried to sideline and weaken Ansarallah by sowing division in northern Yemen only to escalate into an all out war that also ultimately failed to drive the Houthis from power. The Special Committee still operates as Saudi Arabia's secret body that is running the kingdom's policies toward Yemen.

The Plan to Open Multiple Fronts Against Ansarallah The same January 2012 cable names two men tasked with carrying out Salman's plan. The cable claimed Sheikh Mohammed al-Imam, who ran a Salafi institute in the city of Dhamar, "prepared 300 armed men to target Houthi positions" to relieve pressure on the Salafis of Dammaj who were battling the Houthis, though the claim could not be independently verified. Located in the Saada governorate of northwest Yemen, Dammaj was the base of Saudi-influenced Salafi seminary built in the Zaydi heartland in 1979, and by 2012 it had become the symbolic front line of the war. The cable also said that a serving Yemeni army officer, the artillery brigade commander Hussein Khiran, smuggled the fighters their ammunition. It is not clear from the cables that Drop Site obtained whether these specific actions were taken, but Saudi Arabia did back, arm, and fund Salafi fighters to battle Ansarallah. The cable also said that Ansarallah leader Abdulmalik al-Houthi sent envoys to two estranged Zaydi figures, Mohammed Abdulazim and Abdullah al-Razami, to plead for fighters. "We now cannot resist the Wahhabis," Abdulmalik al-Houthi reportedly said, referring to the Salafi tribes. "If you do not support us we will hand Saada over to them, because we cannot continue." Abdulazim refused the request, while Al-Razami sent seventy men, according to the cable. A separate cable records the money. Saudi Prince Mishal bin Abdullah, then governor of the border province of Najran, signed an Interior Ministry cable dated May 7, 2012 under the subject line "Regarding the Houthis and the Sunnis." The cable states that Mishal's office received an installment of five million Saudi Riyals (about $1.3 million) and passed the money to the Dammaj and Aahim fronts before requesting a second installment of funds. The cable also reports that the kingdom's men armed and supplied the Aahim front in the province of Hajjah and were arranging to open a third front in Rahub. It also endorses a plan by a Salafi sheikh named Musleh bin Hamad Fanis Al-Athla to build a new branch of the Dammaj institute, calling it "a good thing" that "helps weaken the Houthi movement." Saudi Arabia had been financially backing anti-Houthi Yemeni border tribes for years. Before Salman's 2012 plan to engineer a rift in the north, a special committee cable dated signed by King Abdullah authorized the immediate release of 50 million Saudi riyals (around $13 million) to arm, supply, and financially support the tribes battling Ansarallah along the border. A March 2012 from the General Intelligence Presidency (GIP), a powerful Saudi intelligence agency, signed by intelligence chief Muqrin bin Abdulaziz describes former president Ali Abdullah Saleh secretly funding the Houthis as a counterweight to Salafi forces. By the report's account, he steered some 12 billion Yemeni riyals (roughly $55.8 million) their way over an undisclosed time period, because the movement "poses an obstacle to the Salafi current in Yemen." While Saleh did support the Houthis at various times, the Saudi intelligence assessment claiming billions of Yemeni riyals could not be independently verified and may have been exaggerated by informants in a bid to prompt Saudi to provide more funding to counter it. Saudi Arabia armed one side. Saleh backed the other. The Zaydi north absorbed the war that both were funding and the damage was catastrophic. Fighting in Dammaj continued from October 2011 to January 2014 and spread to other Houthi strongholds in Saada, Hajjah, Amran and al-Jawf. Casualty numbers and damage reports appear throughout the Saudi cables, quoting Houthi commanders and often citing "large [casualty] numbers from both sides." The Red Cross documented more than 100 dead in the first siege of Dammaj in late 2011, among them four children. from Yemen's health authorities counted 199 killed, 29 of them children, and 594 wounded in the final hundred days alone. When a ceasefire was implemented in January 2014, three hundred buses evacuated roughly 10,000 people, evacuating foreigners and those who sought to escape what was understood to be another round of inevitable fighting. In early 2014, the Houthis overran Dammaj and expelled the Salafi students Riyadh had paid to protect. By September 2014 they had taken over the capital, Sana'a. The covert war escalated into a full blown conflict in March 2015 when a Saudi-led coalition of Gulf nations, with American military, intelligence and logistical support, began a years-long bombing campaign of northern Yemen. While Salman wanted to ensure the fighting did not appear as a Sunni-Shia sectarian war, the kingdom did ultimately play on sectarianism to rally Salafist Sunnis to join its campaign against Ansarallah. The bombing campaign lasted eight years across over 25,000 strikes, nearly a of which struck civilian sites. The accompanying naval and air blockade contributed to the world's largest cholera outbreak in history, and what the UN for years called the world's worst humanitarian crisis. By the end of 2021, the UN put the war's toll at 377,000 dead, most of them from hunger and disease. Ansarallah, the movement Salman's ministry once hoped to fracture, has remained in control of most of Yemen for the past decade. It has fired sporadic missiles at Israel in solidarity with Gaza and targeted commercial ships in the Red Sea, most recently declaring a blockade on all Saudi vessels through the Bab al-Mandab strait. The cables show how Saudi Arabia tried to sideline and weaken Ansarallah by sowing division in northern Yemen only to escalate into an all out war that also ultimately failed to drive the Houthis from power. Hi there —
lately, there’s been a lot of talk about the “5 things that are worth the
money,” and I wanted to take a moment and share my list with you:

1. A quality pair of running shoes. As a mom, puppy parent, and runner, a
comfortable pair of shoes is worth every cent. Whether on a family hike
around the Great Lakes, taking Lily for a walk, or a run-club meeting, my
running shoes have seen it all.

2. A pistachio latte at Haraz Coffee. If you know, you know!

3. Tickets to a Detroit Tigers Game. I’ve lived in the best city in the
world for over 20 years. There’s no better place to spend a sunny Sunday
afternoon. I’ve been able to watch the resilience, community, and grit
that makes Detroit so special.

4. A great pair of sunglasses! 🕶️ From campaign stops to run clubs, a
great pair of sunglasses is invaluable.

5. A donation to keep the Michigan Governor’s office blue. I may be biased
here, but holding this seat is the most important thing we can do to fix
problems for everyday Michiganders.

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/10230?t=1002&akid=1750%2E181023%2EpN_i_W ]If you’re with me, can you chip in $5 to my campaign today to help me

body:
Finally, some good news!
Finally, some good news!
| Patriot,
---
What a turnaround!
---
After poll after poll showed the Democrats trouncing us in voter enthusiasm all year, the latest polling shows MAGA has finally regained the upper hand!
---
**Newsweek: “MAGA More Motivated Than Democrats for 2026 Midterms: Poll”**

“Trump/MAGA Republicans were the most likely to say they were "definitely going to vote" in the 2026 congressional midterm elections on November 3: **75 percent of MAGA respondents expressed that enthusiasm** [compared to] **63 percent of Democrats.”**
---
The best part? Our Party’s FIRST-EVER Midterm Convention at the end of the summer is the perfect opportunity to boost GOP voter enthusiasm even _further_!
---
__For MAGA, only 75% of our voters being “high propensity” who will “definitely” vote in the midterms is still close to the floor. We need to be aiming for the ceiling, which is 100%!__
---
But before I get ahead of myself, I want to highlight something important:
---
“Voter enthusiasm ahead of an election is... an early indicator of turnout strength and campaign engagement, **_although self-reported voting intention does not necessarily translate into actual turnout.”_ **
---
That last part is why we can’t take our foot off the gas for even a second.
---
**We need to capitalize on this new lead in enthusiasm by verifying every last Republican voter to ensure that they’re a “high propensity” voter who is actually going to show up to vote on – _or before_ – November 3rd. **
---
As long as we do that, we’ll win the midterms!

Given the vital importance of voter verification, I took it upon myself to review our Party’s list of voter profiles that were not fully verified as “high propensity” voters.

I’ll admit – I was surprised to see your name on there, Patriot.

_That’s why I’m personally reaching out to ask _YOU_ to fully verify your profile. Because if we fully verify the remaining 25% of MAGA voters, our advantage will become insurmountable! _

Friend,

The President’s latest address, which rehashed old grievances and lies from the 2020 election, was a direct, calculated threat to our democratic system designed to erode public trust. We are facing a coordinated effort by this President to disenfranchise voters through legislation like the SAVE Act, but Democrats are ready to respond with voter mobilization and a robust legal team.

Will you contribute $15 or $25 to help us mobilize voters and defend our fundamental rights across MD-03? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/SEMD-03-Email-July2026-FR-ElectionIntegrity?&refcode=E30938-20260728-ElectionIntegrity-SL-Trump&amount=25]

This is not a political debate we can afford to watch from the sidelines. Every single citizen in Howard, Anne Arundel, and Carroll counties deserves a transparent electoral system free from unlawful interference. Following that address, I made my stance unequivocally clear: taking an oath to support and defend the Constitution means fighting to protect ballot access, secure our election infrastructure, and hold bad-actor politicians accountable.

Defending our democracy against these attacks requires clear-eyed legislative leadership, but we also need to make sure every voter knows their rights before they step up to vote. That process takes resources.

Please pitch in to power our response and defend our democratic process. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/SEMD-03-Email-July2026-FR-ElectionIntegrity?&refcode=E30938-20260728-ElectionIntegrity-SL-Trump&amount=25]

[ stdin# ]Josh Shapiro for Pennsylvania
Want to know a campaign secret,
Derek?

Believe it or not, the further out from Election Day you are, the more
your donation matters. So your $10 donation here in July? It’s worth a lot
more than a $100 donation in November.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/5035?t=1001&akid=157%2E245147%2EWTtAia ]If that’s all the context you need, will you make your first $10 donation of the
year to help us stay up on the air, hit our $150,000
End-of-Month fundraising goal, and make sure Trump’s donors can’t tilt the
scales of this election here in battleground Pennsylvania?

Here’s what we mean: When you chip in now, more than three months out from
Election Day, your donation is extremely flexible.

We can use it to extend a TV ad for a few more days, open up a new field
office, or even hire an extra staffer! Things change fast here in
Pennsylvania — so having the flexibility to change our strategy on a dime
is so, so important for a campaign like ours.

But if you wait until November? We don’t have that flexibility. There’s no
time to film a new ad or open a new office.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/5035?t=1002&akid=157%2E245147%2EWTtAia ]So Derek, if
you know you’re planning to donate in October or November, we have a
humble request: Will you make that donation right now? We still need to
raise over $65,000 to hit our End-of-Month fundraising goal and expand our
voter outreach programs, and we can’t reach it unless folks like you step
up. Not in November. Not in October. But right now.

name: Troy Jackson
subject: How we win this race and defeat Susan Collins
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lofgren for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/e-zl-troy-jackson-split-q32026?refcode=EM_ALL_ZOL_FRS_1_2026-07-28_TJK_SPL_ES-53428&amount=26

Peter,
Growing up in Allagash and spending years working 80-hour weeks in the woods to make ends meet, I know firsthand what working Mainers need from our government.

And for 30 years, Susan Collins has failed us. Time and again, she has sold us out to Donald Trump and his MAGA agenda while pretending we’re too dumb to notice. And I’m sick of it.

My name is Troy Jackson. I’m a proud Mainer, father, and fifth-generation logger.

This weekend, I officially earned the Democratic nomination for U.S. Senate. Now it’s time to defeat Susan Collins and her billionaire backers. So I’m asking you to split a donation between my campaign and Rep. Zoe Lofgren to become a Founding Donor to my campaign right now and help us win the most important Senate race in the country. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/e-zl-troy-jackson-split-q32026?refcode=EM_ALL_ZOL_FRS_1_2026-07-28_TJK_SPL_ES-53428&amount=26]

DONATE NOW >>
{FirstName or 'Friend'}}, let me tell you a bit about what this race means to me.

When I was growing up, I was a poor kid in a town full of poor kids. My family relied on food assistance at times. I distinctly remember when I was 13 years old, we didn’t have heat or running water, and I heard my mother quietly crying to herself, wishing she could do more for us.

After high school, I became a logger like my dad, and his dad, and his dad before him. When a greedy landowner tried to screw my fellow loggers and me out of fair wages, I fought back. A whole bunch of politicians, including then-first-term Senator Susan Collins, promised to listen, but they left us high and dry — and I realized that nothing would change unless there were working-class voices in power.
So I ran for the Maine legislature, where I served 20 years, including six years as the President of the Maine Senate. It’s been the honor of my life to fight for working people.

I drove hours each way between the North Woods and the State Capitol, because that's what the job required. I won those elections in a district that went for Trump by 20 points, because up here, people care less about a label and more about whether you give a damn about their family.

{FirstName or 'Friend'}}, I’m building this campaign the right way. With grassroots support from folks like you. I’m not running to impress the billionaires or the corporate class. I’m running for the mom who’s worried about how she’ll fill her gas tank this week. I’m running for the kid whose whole life will be determined by the quality of his education. I’m running to ensure every working family in Maine has the government they deserve.

If you believe in this fight and our movement, I’m humbly asking you to split a donation between my campaign and Rep. Zoe Lofgren today to help us reach our fundraising goal and take on the GOP’s millions. Even $5 makes a difference >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/e-zl-troy-jackson-split-q32026?refcode?amount=5]

In solidarity with you always,
Troy Jackson

body:
| I grew up in a working-class family in Allagash.

We didn’t always have heat or running water. Sometimes, we relied on food assistance to make ends meet.

My dad was a logger out in the woods, and one day he and his fellow loggers had to stand up to a wealthy landowner who was threatening their wages. They weren’t even asking for more money, they just wanted to be paid fairly.

_“Take the pay cut or go home,”_ they were told.

I’ll never forget that day. I was only 11 years old, and watched my dad fight for something bigger than all of us — a basic fairness every worker should be entitled to, the ability to make ends meet, the ability to put food on the table for their family.

I know what it’s like to worry about paying the bills on time. I know what it’s like to fight, not just for your own future, but for the future of everyone around you, too.

And it’s that _fight_ I’ll bring to the United States Senate. For too long, our voices have been ignored and crushed by powerful corporations and special interests who make backroom deals with greedy politicians.

Now’s our chance to change that. We have less than 100 days to build a campaign big enough to win. But with your help today, I know we can do it. I promise you I’ll spend every day in the Senate fighting for you and your families.

clean_body: | I grew up in a working-class family in Allagash. We didn’t always have heat or running water. Sometimes, we relied on food assistance to make ends meet. My dad was a logger out in the woods, and one day he and his fellow loggers had to stand up to a wealthy landowner who was threatening their wages. They weren’t even asking for more money, they just wanted to be paid fairly. “Take the pay cut or go home,” they were told. I’ll never forget that day. I was only 11 years old, and watched my dad fight for something bigger than all of us — a basic fairness every worker should be entitled to, the ability to make ends meet, the ability to put food on the table for their family. I know what it’s like to worry about paying the bills on time. I know what it’s like to fight, not just for your own future, but for the future of everyone around you, too. And it’s that fight I’ll bring to the United States Senate. #
Peter,
A New York Times/Siena poll shows Latino voters are moving decisively toward Democrats:
Apr 2025: Dems +8 🔵
Jan 2026: Dems +16 🔵
May 2026: Dems +30 🔵
**That’s a 22-point shift in just one year.**
Latinos are energized, and this surge can flip the House and Senate this November — but only if we make sure they are registered and cast their ballots.
**But right now, millions of eligible Latino voters are still unregistered in battleground states. That’s why Voto Latino is racing to reach them before it’s too late.**
If you’ve been waiting for the right time to make a donation to Voto Latino, now is the time. [**Will you rush your first-ever donation today to help boost our voter registration and turnout efforts in these final 14 weeks until Election Day?**](https://act.votolatino.org/go/305?c0=em-ms-voto-20260728-2.ikoYBu&refcode=em20260728-423&t=2&akid=423%2E1366028%2EbE3eCD)
In the closest races, even a small boost in turnout could be the difference between Trump’s allies keeping control and our communities finally having real power and accountability in Washington.
And the path to the majority runs through the Latino community.
That is why Voto Latino is going all in on voter registration and turnout right now.
We’re focused on **22 battleground congressional districts across 8 states** — California, Nevada, Arizona, Colorado, Pennsylvania, New York, Virginia, and Texas — where Latino voters could decide the outcome.
But reaching — and turning out — eligible Latino voters takes resources.
**[It costs $26 to identify, contact, and register one new Latino voter. Hey, it's Mandela Barnes -- I need to ask you something.
If you knew you could help defeat Trump's hand-picked candidate in a state that flipped red in 2024 -- would you?
If you knew you could keep a MAGA loyalist out of the Governor's office in Wisconsin -- would you?
If you knew you could help elect a working-class champion who refuses to take a single dime from corporate PACs -- would you?
I think you would. And that's exactly why I'm writing to you today.
### **Here 's the situation.**
Wisconsin flipped red in 2024, and Tom Tiffany and his MAGA billionaire backers are counting on it happening again. They've got the dark money, the seven-figure ad buys, and the full weight of Donald Trump's billionaire brigade behind them. They're spending aggressively, they're organized, and they believe this state is theirs to keep.
They think they can waltz to victory, but here's what they're not accounting for: our grassroots movement.
### **Our movement is built from the ground up.**
I'm running this race for the working families who Donald Trump and Tom Tiffany have abandoned. The folks who are stretched thin right now. The same ones who are trying to keep up with rising costs, navigate a healthcare system that wasn't built for them, and hold onto their right to vote in a state where those rights are under attack.
That's who I wake up thinking about every single day. Not donors. Not special interests. Not Donald Trump.
I don't take corporate PAC money. This campaign runs on grassroots support from people who believe Wisconsin deserves better than a MAGA rubber stamp in the Governor's mansion.
### **Our campaign represents what people power actually looks like.**
It's hard to overstate how much your support truly means. When thousands of people each pitch in whatever they can, it adds up to something that no billionaire can match: **genuine, people-powered momentum that persuades voters and wins races.**
Tom Tiffany has never had to answer to working families - only to billionaires and Donald Trump. And he wants us to believe that he'll change his mind as governor? _Sure, Tom._
Look, new polls show I'm the only Democrat in this race that can beat Tom Tiffany. Our message is resonating with voters, we just have to get it out far and wide before Election Day on August 11th.
**[So, will you help us flip Wisconsin blue and pitch in $10 right now? We have a major end-of-month goal coming up - our last before the primary election - and I need your support now more than ever.](https://substack.com/redirect/a167c509-080b-4d86-9cd1-32edb594cfa2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[FLIP WISCONSIN BLUE ->](https://substack.com/redirect/a167c509-080b-4d86-9cd1-32edb594cfa2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
If you can help today, I'm asking you to do it.
All my best,
Mandela

If you knew you could keep a MAGA loyalist out of the Governor's office in Wisconsin -- would you? If you knew you could help elect a working-class champion who refuses to take a single dime from corporate PACs -- would you? I think you would. And that's exactly why I'm writing to you today. Here 's the situation. Wisconsin flipped red in 2024, and Tom Tiffany and his MAGA billionaire backers are counting on it happening again. They've got the dark money, the seven-figure ad buys, and the full weight of Donald Trump's billionaire brigade behind them. They're spending aggressively, they're organized, and they believe this state is theirs to keep. They think they can waltz to victory, but here's what they're not accounting for: our grassroots movement. Our movement is built from the ground up. This campaign runs on grassroots support from people who believe Wisconsin deserves better than a MAGA rubber stamp in the Governor's mansion. Our campaign represents what people power actually looks like. It's hard to overstate how much your support truly means. When thousands of people each pitch in whatever they can, it adds up to something that no billionaire can match: genuine, people-powered momentum that persuades voters and wins races. Tom Tiffany has never had to answer to working families - only to billionaires and Donald Trump. And he wants us to believe that he'll change his mind as governor? Sure, Tom. Look, new polls show I'm the only Democrat in this race that can beat Tom Tiffany. Our message is resonating with voters, we just have to get it out far and wide before Election Day on August 11th. If you can help today, I'm asking you to do it. All my best, Mandela | | | | | (C) 2026 Mandela Barnes 548 Market Street PMB 72296, San Francisco, CA 94104 ? ?

We're not cowering in the face of voter suppression, and we refuse to give up the fight to increase voter participation across the country. We're focusing all our energy on registering and turning out every voter we can .

For those of us who couldn't make it to Selma, Montgomery, or other places to march? We have to do everything we can to register a tidal wave of voters across the country.
Voter registration is a critical part of grassroots efforts to protect voting rights. The more people who vote, the more our government looks like we, the people. But to get to the point where every voice is heard, we need your help .

Finally, some good news!
| Fellow Patriot,
---
What a turnaround!
---
After poll after poll showed the Democrats trouncing us in voter enthusiasm all year, the latest polling shows MAGA has finally regained the upper hand!
---
**Newsweek: “MAGA More Motivated Than Democrats for 2026 Midterms: Poll”**

“Trump/MAGA Republicans were the most likely to say they were "definitely going to vote" in the 2026 congressional midterm elections on November 3: **75 percent of MAGA respondents expressed that enthusiasm** [compared to] **63 percent of Democrats.”**
---
The best part? Our Party’s FIRST-EVER Midterm Convention at the end of the summer is the perfect opportunity to boost GOP voter enthusiasm even _further_!
---
__For MAGA, only 75% of our voters being “high propensity” who will “definitely” vote in the midterms is still close to the floor. We need to be aiming for the ceiling, which is 100%!__
---
But before I get ahead of myself, I want to highlight something important:
---
“Voter enthusiasm ahead of an election is... an early indicator of turnout strength and campaign engagement, **_although self-reported voting intention does not necessarily translate into actual turnout.”_ **
---
That last part is why we can’t take our foot off the gas for even a second.
---
**We need to capitalize on this new lead in enthusiasm by verifying every last Republican voter to ensure that they’re a “high propensity” voter who is actually going to show up to vote on – _or before_ – November 3rd. **
---
As long as we do that, we’ll win the midterms!
---
Given the vital importance of voter verification, I took it upon myself to review our Party’s list of voter profiles that were not fully verified as “high propensity” voters.
---
I’ll admit – I was surprised to see your name on there, Fellow Patriot.

_That’s why I’m personally reaching out to ask _YOU_ to fully verify your profile. Because if we fully verify the remaining 25% of MAGA voters, our advantage will become insurmountable! _

Peter, Roy Cooper here. I’m worried.
We’re coming up on our crucial end-of-month deadline, and unfortunately, we’re not where we need to be to reach our goal. [**_If you’re able to chip in today for the first time to help us get back on track, it would make a big impact and mean a lot to me._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk821&amount=5&t=9&akid=2374%2E124072%2EqXXMe-)
Here’s why we’re trying to raise $1.5 million (I know – it’s ambitious) before the end of the month:
North Carolina is where the fight for U.S. Senate control will be won or lost. Flipping this seat is a _must_ if we’re going to take back the majority, and that’s why the GOP is going all in to defeat me.
Republican super PACs are flooding this race with nearly $100 million so far to crush our momentum. President Trump is smearing my name to his millions of followers on social media. His buddy Stephen Miller even went on Fox News recently to rant and rave about me.
Their attacks are working: We’re getting outspent, and the latest poll of this race shows my narrow lead shrinking by almost half.
**If folks like you chip in and we hit our $1.5 million goal, we’ll be able to keep up with the GOP and ensure this race stays competitive. If we don’t meet this goal, we won’t.**
[**_That’s why this is so important, Peter, so I have to ask: Will you give $5 or whatever amount you can spare today to help us reach our goal, flip North Carolina and take back the Senate majority?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk821&amount=5&t=10&akid=2374%2E124072%2EqXXMe-)

name: Joe Males
subject: What’s your favorite type of bread?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY MALES FOR CONGRESS
body:
Trust me, this is worth the read... |
---

**What’s your favorite type of bread Peter?**

Is it white bread? Whole wheat? Grain? Gluten-free?

So many people around the world don’t get the luxury of choosing a type of bread. But in America, the wealthiest, most prosperous nation in the world, we get that choice. Our grocery stores are chock-full of specialty items; it’s one of the hallmarks of a great capitalist system.

**But our ability to choose is under threat.** In fact, many running for Congress want that gone.

Under a socialist system, you don’t get to choose what type of bread they serve in the bread line. _Just ask the people of Cuba, Venezuela, and Russia._

That’s what’s coming here. _**It’s not a threat; it’s the truth.**_

The Democratic Socialists of America are winning elections across the country, promising free healthcare, universal income, and free childcare. It sounds nice on paper, **_but we all know the consequences._**

Without the free market, our economy collapses. Without money to run a business or shop freely, we become fully reliant on the government to give us our food, shelter, and healthcare.

**I can promise you this;** **when we’re standing next to each other in the breadlines, it won’t matter what your favorite type is.** We will get whatever type of government we can get. And it won’t be good.

**In 2026, Americans have a choice.**

We can choose freedom, or we can choose _totalitarianism._

So many people around the world don’t get the luxury of choosing a type of bread. But in America, the wealthiest, most prosperous nation in the world, we get that choice. Our grocery stores are chock-full of specialty items; it’s one of the hallmarks of a great capitalist system. But our ability to choose is under threat. Just ask the people of Cuba, Venezuela, and Russia. That’s what’s coming here. It’s not a threat; it’s the truth. The Democratic Socialists of America are winning elections across the country, promising free healthcare, universal income, and free childcare. I can promise you this; when we’re standing next to each other in the breadlines, it won’t matter what your favorite type is. We will get whatever type of government we can get. And it won’t be good. Peter, Four days. That's all the early voting window we have left. On August 6th, Tennessee voters will choose their Democratic nominees for the state House and Senate, Congress, Governor, and U.S. Senate. There are also **critical local races** on the ballot from School Board to County Commission in many counties across the state. **This is the primary that sets the table for November 3. Trump Touts Michigan Auto Boom
President Trump traveled to General Motors' Milford proving ground Monday, [crediting his tariffs](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyc0DHO4yAQBeDT2B0RHpuYFC62cZdtt7QwEJiVDYgZEuX2K-8R_gO8p--9P8_tafDAFH6b0y9ItLnsNq7tLJwbk7c55RNtyQda9BtIuAs5C9CbsYxvv02md4uCQb9075dh1go0zHro4zIrGKbd7XqalH4oZR4v7R5Smf21j_sOPS5Xn5xBw6hGKW9q8vCYYR6GUQ3TXXaTbMUZ9jdMhM6TzblcFkZLt1xDfyyRuVA3_upg7WD924g5-uQ_dLP57GAN-e1rOn3iDtZPRPYi5ka-g7XU_MYURKi5JSeK-TrzFf_XkzjRRgwmCa5YBMX8IWEaZ4HJNeL6FRTxxVc-Yoh9XVz54HEg3edukuE0eFyEnn_663uBfwEAAP__cOeOPw) for a manufacturing revival in the swing state. He told autoworkers they would no longer be "sold out" to overseas competitors, [pointing to GM's](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckL0SnCAUhZ8GOxy8_sAWFGnsNm1Kh4Wr3gxwHcF18vYZ8wgpT3O-c75f7-XtKFLefrqElkpZAoelnlc6Kl-1oOfMifzBkTzhAgomqbQEszhf6YvL4JpgR-jMahq0nTYjGNCma3arffDGoEL46DXgZMwr9GZYce1h1cY0ZJ8-pcFAP_ZKteOA8NKgu64fu2FSYlDXEVzFlnKhgMUzH8-WSr60fG5NtHutRxH9DwGzgPm-7_Z2Zae8Vc6VEpbWcxIwZ7yLgPkhCph_X_EJWsD8763cHcUiE_mdNpeluyrLD3OSxf0pMrtKnIvMLCPnDU95UIxuQwFzc9pw3BQjlUmLQW3JUXygTf1fo18LfwMAAP__u0uI3Q) multibillion-dollar domestic investment. The president tied Section 232 auto duties directly to reshored production and rising wages. Speaking from the heart of Detroit's industry, [Trump praised GM's](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckDGOwyAQAF8DXaxlDWZdUFzjLtdeaa2BJCvZxgokvuef8oV7wIxG83Odryyr7Pdv3nKQWudU0tyer-1o5dVqjmUvm8SjrBIlzwg4XMBfkGaOTd55tqxTcGjoRjoH48khoSejH6F3vCRv-8XjMmaGgXhxTDguPEZLrCV8fOCRsHc9QOdsxtGjN6Z3xg6gLLyOxC13sldJucZSjk9Lk1i78rzrNTxaO6rqvxROCqfzPLtb-d3zWbtYNoXTW1IuCqfBAiKBITAG9TOk45R1lTp4ZeG-sawfQLf_XngH_AsAAP__SUdr0Q) comeback and contrasted his trade approach with past administrations. The stop doubled as a midterm-season pitch, with the White House touting roughly 170,000 protected manufacturing jobs statewide and nearly six million nationally. ★★★
Trump Presses Thune On Passing The SAVE Act
President Trump demanded Senate Majority Leader John Thune cancel the chamber's August recess until the SAVE America Act passes, [renewing his call](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckL1urDAQhZ8GOiMz_NhbuLgN3d42JRrsYXcUsC3GLHn8aCPlBdIfnXO-7-M-35E3jo__uJNjkTmkMJfj3HNJZxHyKaadfU4be6YZNIxKGwV2Rl_4RXOPdXADtHa1NbnW2AEsGNvWT2cGwGWxq9VmuXW9MXAjY8eVuqWHYLqa3btPG7DQDZ3WzdAT3AyYtu2Gth911eszByzUcBQOJD6l_P5S2EuTjke9uWcpWaruXwVTBdN1Xc2aviJd0vi0VzD9xiuYfrhUoB1jEFWeZyT1SZSVUMRCSkiEU1RnLLwpwRcp3Olgjwp9URlFSOrDhXzxtrGMpur1Y0fe3lt1-avAl4PvAAAA__8_JoR_) to terminate the legislative filibuster. Three Republicans — Mike Lee, Rick Scott, and Ashley Moody — [joined the push](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckDGunjAQhE9jukVmjTEULtLQvbQpkZ-9P2xibAubP8rtI6Kc4DWrLUYz38yPj-3DceS0f3cnWa51Czls7brP0vLdKvmc8sm-5MieaUOJE0gDOG_ON37TNrouWI3D_Jo7soOZNc5o5qE7rHo5_HR6USYE47QPWoclTK_lE5X2Bju2j580OKPSSspej4SLQTMMSg_jJMUo7xJco55T5UDV51welsa-9vnau2iP1koV6pvAVeAaHMc_3sVIV-_zKXB9IgSu0jz_c_61AwV7LlApuZavCo1ihJ_5SNCOOxG0DL-I_gsIcqEEd2ocobo3gfMNuEJxtVIAgWt32VB-c4xcJyNGuZ-O40PQta_O-rb4NwAA__9J7okq), vowing to object to any adjournment vote. The voter-ID and proof-of-citizenship measure has stalled under the 60-vote threshold. Trump urged senators to skip the monthlong break, [warning them not](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckL2SrCAQhZ8GMyxof3ACgpuYzU03tHoAnd5CoGwcX3_LfYQNT_J955yv5_JEipS2_7gHS8yLz36px7mXms_KweWUd3IlR3IUFlAwSmUkTAu6Sp-w9Nh4O4Ce1qkJVptpgAnMpJu3NWbEwY3aeP9ysIJRZgyjebgHol9X3ZC9ecrABN3QKdUOfYCHAaN1N-h-VKJXZ_FYQ0uJyQd2OZe7SyXHbT62Jtp3rYVF90_ALGC-rqu9kN-UtppTpT1w6_IuYE7hYgHzbRQwf5_xDkbA7HPC6OXvaOkwRpYcEtYgj1DOVySHiaXD5EKUeG4nV_lBh5VykgX5pjaH9eWiGIlHI3q17UjxFjf1r69-LPwEAAD__9wrioU) to "leave town" before delivering. Thune poured cold water on the effort, saying he saw no path to 60 votes and no appetite to change Senate rules. ★★★
New Tariffs Target Forced Labor
The administration is defending sweeping new tariffs on roughly 60 countries, imposed under Section 301 over failures to enforce forced-labor import bans. U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said America is [the only country](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckDGOwyAQAF8DXaxlwYALimvc5dorLQKbZCXboEDie_7JX7gHzGg0P9flGnnl_fEdNwrc2pJLXvrrvdVe3r1RKnvZONWycmJaENBewF3QLzF1_tBiosxhROXvXlJQzo_o0XklnyGhtdbnKU8motU4UboZnAzeNCGpJDmcPnDoUY8aYBgN4eTQKaVHZSwIA--aY6eB98aZWiqlni2dUxvK6yHX8Oy9NqG_BM4C5-M4hnv53eloQyqbwPnDmYrA2RpADaDBKYXyFXI9eF25WScMPLbI6wnI_t8Ln4B_AQAA___Oi2tE) that still enforces century-old anti-slavery trade laws. Partners adopting bans face a 10% duty, while those that don't [see 12.5%](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckDGOhCAYRk8D3Rj4QPktKLaxm223NAo48ycqZmDGPf7GK-wB3svL-7mP94lX3h_f05Y8lzLGHMf6em9Hze9aUsh73jgceeXAaYRCd1PuBhqnUPmTRjvJ6FtoWkgmrx21IDjS8umxqL5r57SEeYZ2LhAZA9gFNFOAkuwvn3IgmNYo1bQ2oXdwWptW204Jq95HnGpqeC8cUwk5H1dL5VCa_HrI1T9rPYowXwKDwHCeZ7Pk3z2dpQl5Exg-HFMWGDqrgN6Q7bWGfPl4nLyuXDonrHpsE68XIOt_L3w8_gIAAP__18drUw). Greer argued the measures level the playing field for U.S. firms that already reject goods made under coercion. Critics call the move an [end-run around](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckLGyniAQhZ8GOxxcRUhBkcbupk3pIKz-myDrAF5fP-MrpDunOd-Z7_fX-uUpUT5--RMd1bpGjmsr93k1vlvFwJlPChcnCoQrKJilMhLs6kOjb1wn30WnYbC77dANxmqwYOzQfZxVYTRxD3reNc5mQ7vHbUc_jvumEaAj9-4pAxZGPSrV6wnhhwEzDKMeplmJSd1X9A17ypUi1sB8vV8ahdpzObrkPq1dVYw_BSwClud5-sfXD-WjcW50Yu0DnwKWjE8VsLxEAcufO73ljaH48Dfyk-XOJWCUyW9cJOYoy52lL3znKAPno2CtMlKtGBrlQ0bOPkUBS1dcvB5KiepsxKSO01N6uV37X6nfDv4FAAD__-d2iow) Congress, but the White House says re-industrialization and worker protection justify the aggressive posture.
Fishback survives ballot fight

A Florida judge dismissed Lt. Gov. Jay Collins's suit over gubernatorial candidate James Fishback's residency, [keeping Fishback](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckDuSnTAQRVcjMlGikUAvIHBCNk4dUj368HqsD0WLwd69iy04u9E9p86vj-0DKVHZf2IOCzFvvvqtnVc-Wr0aB1dLzeSOmshR2EDBJNUswW7oGn2HTWPnFwODjbYLyzBbAxZmO3TvBaI1Tkfwdhq9Uq9oJhi9jzFqP5rh1dHy_KkZLIxmVKo3OsBrhnkYRjPoSQmtrsNjCz0VJh_Y1Xo8Lo0c9_Xcu7S8WztYjD8ErALW-777G_lNZW-1hD-YqYSzdzULWEu4WcDqMB9Ie3k2N2xBwKqnyej5JWD9whxYRuL3J7rfkhv-lTHVkzzKT0ypNvl1-T1IT5yJWSa8-aImYO3OxR83pUQ8zUKrPSOlh921_237vcC_AAAA__8NKYyh) on the primary ballot after finding insufficient evidence to rebut his qualification.
