Trump Touts Michigan Auto Boom
President Trump traveled to General Motors' Milford proving ground Monday, [crediting his tariffs](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckL2u4yAQhZ_G7oicAcekoNjG3d12S4sLEzMr8yMYHOXtV76PsN1pvnOOvj9f25elg9L-20Y07qTNZ79x7bFw7tzQ5ZQjuZIPcoQbTPAQ0yJAb9YxnbgpO3rj_EPCiOa-6Bk0aDmNwQDq6Sm_XxbRfWuNSlkpHcDyhKed5TySueqmBTTIWarlNiu8I87zS-u7RKUHNfXiLWO7uZwa1tNem5RSvlJON5fjeJjAXNogfw2wDrD-7Y05YML3hcUB1j2fWFPExAOs70CMIuTecIC11HxS2sVec09eFPvx9iN-BDQRyQXabRJcqYgW8rsJ2zkLSr43rh_RAr344gPtYazGlzcdB7XHMqhpj5aOn4v8v2pPA_8CAAD__501kK4) for a manufacturing revival in the swing state. He told autoworkers they would no longer be "sold out" to overseas competitors, [pointing to GM's](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckL2ynTAMhJ_GdD4Dso19Cxdp6G7alIxidEAZ_zDHBiZvn4FHSCcVu9_u_vqev5Ej5_UnJvLh5Hkpy9w-R9pbOVqlUHJJHPYSOTDN0MMoeyvBzRganzRr7BYfllFBR36wzoADp_pu86MxoVcLangjaWsHHJ2iL_Uexi9lrenY33a9BQfKKG1fRtNAZMzbuUGRdkL3x75go_oKJVf6nHgzOedyXyW_Qkld9FtrexXqh4BJwHRd1-vCunFeW8mN0yNPAqZMVxUw3VQB058j3o8VMD2F5YYcq0wcNl4xSzxakb9LSbLi3yrzQ6wyFxlLXukjd44RVxIwdR-_7BfHyHW0QvdrQo5PuPa_o54e_gUAAP__jjWKQw) multibillion-dollar domestic investment. The president tied Section 232 auto duties directly to reshored production and rising wages. Speaking from the heart of Detroit's industry, [Trump praised GM's](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyc0D2O7CAQBODT4GyspgFDQvASZ_PSDS0E7ZmW-LHG2N7jr7xH2KyS-kqqr-fyDJy5vv6HQj6evKSWlv45ytbb0XeKrbbCcWuZI9OCgNMD7APdEmLnkxYdhuRjmhQO5KV1Bh06BcPbGx0TrJNdpSYDgQJCQGtkNFEZtcqB_c2BRYfKKG1Ho0kSGbM6JxVpJzQcWwqd9jG2utPnDPcm19ru1OoYWxmyf_e-7UL9EzgLnK_rGtf2Xem6a0XgfHKiJnCeNCA6kA6kxOHj03ZxzrxPVmh4lcD5F-x_PeL0-BMAAP__PB1t0Q) comeback and contrasted his trade approach with past administrations. The stop doubled as a midterm-season pitch, with the White House touting roughly 170,000 protected manufacturing jobs statewide and nearly six million nationally. ★★★
Trump Presses Thune On Passing The SAVE Act
President Trump demanded Senate Majority Leader John Thune cancel the chamber's August recess until the SAVE America Act passes, [renewing his call](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckL1ygzAQhJ8GOjHySYBcqEhD57QpGUU67Jugn-EE5PEz-BHSbbO73-7XY344Wik9P11E6w-aQw5z3fZYat4ro88pR_Ilr-QJZ5AwCDkKMLPzlQ6ctWuD9WFQ0KK9jaYHA0bJ9mUXP3wDhAEULqjuqFWQIyo5egX6LlVL9oqTIxhQvdJj12u8Ifb9YsxNoTaNlnsJriJ3PifG7XBXJ6WUL5VT53NsV_uqtXCjPhqYGpjO8-yW_JvwvGyxgemir-S5gek9TQSMLgUW9bUnFD-IRTAmV1EwMlNOYk-VVsHuQOEibuSdcL6K4piR282GctK6Eg9jo-UzOlrfLPW_Hx4W_gIAAP__Q92HBQ) to terminate the legislative filibuster. Three Republicans — Mike Lee, Rick Scott, and Ashley Moody — [joined the push](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLHu3CAMh5-GbD4REw5uYOiS7d-1Y-QD34WWAAokVd--yqlP0MX6JFv-7N-Pr-WLYor5_Z02dv6MSyhh6fux1V6O3tiXXLboa0nRR15Q4h2kAbQL-R5PXiYagvPhrnBgNxqr0aJVcljd-JCox-dLP57qGe6GSD4fhl_aTGgN0xDdtU4atKi0msxNTzwya_2ydlQ8WTHJowbq3G6-5Mb7SZcz5lwuKvnmyzYkt_Zem1DfBM4C50Ax_fGUEu9XX-B8aQTO0lx8lc-DoOBdKjTO1MveoHNK8LOsGfp6ZIZe4BfzvwGGUjnDkXtM0OhkIN8hNqjUGgcQOA-7C_V3TCm2uxGTfG8U0-fC_r_Jng7_BgAA___lEos2), vowing to object to any adjournment vote. The voter-ID and proof-of-citizenship measure has stalled under the 60-vote threshold. Trump urged senators to skip the monthlong break, [warning them not](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLHSpSAMhZ8GO-5IwCsWFNvY_dtu6UTI9WYHwRHU19_RR9guKXK-L-fPz_SDHDktv3El50-eQg5T3Y91q_mohXxOeWW_5cieaYIW3rLtJdgJfeWTJoNNcD68NTTkVG87sGB123xdQDX4QQ_GdmYe5g9o1fn-g4qQ5kGpht0d1_ZgQXfa9K_OkCLquo-1SpOxwrTHFrBSefmcCu0n3kxOKd9TTi-f1ya6b61bEfqXgFHAeF3X68Ly5bTUnCqvz_kqYEx0FQHjTRUw_j3ivfQCxpATxiCfv6XHGIsslLCS3Gk75sgeU5Eek6co8ViOUuWJ_nGQG5Y7tdld2C6Okcu7F6ZdVuT4CNb_LfZ08C8AAP__ssWMug) to "leave town" before delivering. Thune poured cold water on the effort, saying he saw no path to 60 votes and no appetite to change Senate rules. ★★★
New Tariffs Target Forced Labor
The administration is defending sweeping new tariffs on roughly 60 countries, imposed under Section 301 over failures to enforce forced-labor import bans. U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said America is [the only country](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyc0L-OszAQBPCnMV3Qem2wU7j4Grp87ZXIsZdkJf9BwcA9_ol7hOummd9I8_WYH54Tl9d_n8mFg-dY49w-e15b3dtGoZaaOaw1cWCaEXC8gbmhnX1ofNCsfRddiKPCjpw0dkCLVkH3dhZJ35dhhDFKWvxTyngnshKkMfH-jB27iwODFtWgtOkHTZJoGBZrpSJthYZ9jb7R1odaNvoc_trkUuqVaulDzV1y79bWTah_AieB03me_VK_C51XLQucDo5UBU6jBlQACoyU2H1cXE9OibfRCA2v7Dn9gu2vRxwOfwIAAP__eDFuFw) that still enforces century-old anti-slavery trade laws. Partners adopting bans face a 10% duty, while those that don't [see 12.5%](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyc0L-OszAQBPCnMV2QWdvYKVx8DV2-9kpk1ptkJf9BwcA9_ol7hOummd9I8_WYH4ETl9f_kMnjwXOscW6fPa-t7m0jrKVmxrUmRqYZJIw3aW_g5oCND5p16KLHOCroyA_WGXDglOzePgS8B2tR4dOQXTTJRS4G0TizoDNLx_7ipAUHyihte6NpIDLm6dygSDuh5b7G0GjrsZaNPke4NrmUeqVaeqy5S_7d2roJ9U_AJGA6z7N_1u9C51XLAqaDI1UB06glwF05fR8G6D4-rienxNtohZavHDj9gu2vRxwefgIAAP__J0Ju4A). Greer argued the measures level the playing field for U.S. firms that already reject goods made under coercion. Critics call the move an [end-run around](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckL2ynDAMhZ_GdN4BmR9v4SIN3U2bkvHaWlaJkRjbwOtnuI9wu0-Fznfm_Plavjwl4vW339CFk5Yocan52PYqRy0YhGWjsEuiQLhAC6NuJw128aHSiUvvm-hCHA006LrJDmDBmrb5uOcAr2jM9Hy--s6PA_Th3Xav9xji4MFgQ-6OayewYAbTT4-hxw5xGN7WdgZ7q_r22KOvWB5BuGA-_e0kZrlJ-BFka5L71LoXZX4pmBXM13U9Ll8-xGsVrrR9v28KZsarKJhvq4L575Hu48aQffgX5WL9lhww6uRfkjVy1Plg7bMcHHUQXjOWoiOVgqESrzoK-xQVzE12cb8oJSrjpPp23Tyl7371p7ueDv4HAAD__8pWi_0) Congress, but the White House says re-industrialization and worker protection justify the aggressive posture.
Fishback survives ballot fight

A Florida judge dismissed Lt. Gov. Jay Collins's suit over gubernatorial candidate James Fishback's residency, [keeping Fishback](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckL_OnDAQxJ_GdD7B2oCvcJGG7kubEu3ZC7cX_0HYQPL2EXmEr_tpNJoZza-v-Qs5cFp_YiTrTp599nPdj7jVfNRCLqcc2W05sGOaoYVBtqMEM6OrfNKssfHW-UFBQ7YbTQ8GjGqbtzXamKcZFvV6-sXfOmllVOup8waha9jece0IBlSv9PjoNXVEfb8Y0ynSRuj22DxWKg-XU6H9xLuTU8o35fRwOTbBvmvdilA_BEwCpuu6HheWN6e15kR_MHKi_bYKmBJdRcDkMG7Ia7q5VKwkYNLD0OvxKWD6YKQiFy7vF7rfslT8K5eQd_YoXxhCrvJz-JWk5xK5FBnwKgdXAVOzW79dHAKXYRS6XSNy-D-zfvfe08K_AAAA___G-Y65) on the primary ballot after finding insufficient evidence to rebut his qualification.

★★★
Noem skips home-state race

Former Cabinet secretary Kristi Noem will [sit out](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckD2SnDAQhU8jMk0xjQBtQOCEbJ06pHqlXqZrkJqSGvDxXfgIm33B-6v353P5RN44r78x0RROXqLERcuRdpVDKwXJkjjssnFgWqCFwbajBb9gUD5pcdjEKcShg4am5-h78OC7tnlNfhgdjuidB_cBX99tDME7_4FD9xw9fDU83XHtCB66vnPjo3f0JOr7b--fHTlvXHvsEZXqI0iuVE68OzlnuUnyI0hqtumlulfT_TIwG5iv63pcWF-cV5VMfzFxpnJLDcyZrmpgDph25DXfXBWVDMxuGFzvWwPzu3BVtlko2cparRxqqxz6shHfomhXOalkKbZguL1NmeJ-8bZxHUbj2jUhb__X6U9fPSf4FwAA__-CX4sT) South Dakota's GOP gubernatorial contest, leaving Gov. Larry Rhoden's allies to tout his agriculture and military credentials as the field takes shape.

★★★
Whitmer backs Stevens in Michigan

Gov. Gretchen Whitmer [endorsed establishment favorite](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckL_SnSAQxZ9GOxzughdSUKSx-9KmdPhg1Z0RcGDV3LfPmEdId4rz5zfn99f85WmnvP7yCV24aI4lzlzPdHA5uWEouSQKR9kpEM4g4S2kEWBnH5gunLXvowvxraBH9zJ2BAtWyX5z4CN8m2iWRYZvrdQijQT5QweJEuKy9OSeOmnAghqVNsOo8YU4jou1L4XadlqeR_SMbQglN6yXfzYp5_KokodQUr-7jflonfrZwdTBdN_3sJQ_Ge8nljqYHnqm0DqY1oocNszi3ogTVoE5ltqwiVQiVs8oNr_jRzTGC3MTTOvG4jxCSZRX0TA_nqNS8vXTVxePm_ad2tt0Wq7J0_4Piv_3zMvB3wAAAP__ByWLqA) Rep. Haley Stevens over socialist Abdul El-Sayed in Michigan's Democratic Senate primary, a boost as early voting opens ahead of the August 4 contest.

* * *
Schmitt targets birthright ruling
Missouri Sen. Eric Schmitt [unveiled legislation](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckL2u3CAQhZ8Gd6wwYJtbUKRxd9OmtFiYtUfiTzDeKHn6iH2ENKMjjeZ8n-bX9_HtMGI-f7oE1r_xCCUc1O5UqdzUwZdcEvpaInqEQwq5crFxaQ7nCd9waDcF68Oq5AR23swijTRKTJcF5ZavFZbZGDGH-Sl0WGfx_PL6JWFTYUI76sQmjVSL0ttj0TADLMvLmFmBNkyLuwZH0B--5A7t7QYTcy4jlfzwJU3RXkS1M_WDyZ3JPTiMf7yLEdrYM7kPDJO72EYeAxp63v2VkIhjSni2Tx9_YqOr4XkR90j4F3K_sPJ-1wYJuC93Iz5cCOn-XPgSI5zAey2NOu-QHQGT-9RsqL8xRuzrxrQ4k8P48aX__fPbyn8BAAD__8MPkqg) to restore what he calls the 14th Amendment's original meaning after the Supreme Court struck Trump's birthright citizenship order, blasting the decision as a "ridiculous interpretation." ★★★
Religious Liberty suit tossed

A federal judge [dismissed a challenge](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLtqxDAQRb9G7mzssV4pVASCu00VSGm00mR3QA9jyXby90H5hDTDhQMzZ-7nbb1ZCpQe7zaicSetPvu17kfcaj5qQZdTjuS2HMgRrjCC7EfVg16tq3Tiym3njfNyhg7NpLQADXoeu6exk1SISs6KK85BKKHVC79zlKC5FLwj09aNCjTMYuZqEBwnRCG-tJ5m5Jrx8di8rVgGl1PB_bTtJqWUW8ppcDl2wTxr3QqbXxksDJbruoaEV4n2u3EGS7Ov5AqDZcdAD8pH6QPdca8_vcsxUimUU_-Wkw2-_2jv98Fe5aDKYGmWDJZRtdwGeQbLBJLD1EC3G79dFAIVqRgfH9FS-FOr_630NPAbAAD__x5yhkc) to Trump's Religious Liberty Commission, rejecting an interfaith group's claim that the panel's overwhelmingly conservative Christian makeup lacked legal legitimacy.

Fed decision looms Wednesday
